alexi skarab.name: Alexi Skarab
alexi skarab.origin: Doctor Alexi Skarab was a professor of Egyptology working in the city of Cairo. He was also (allegedly) a direct descendent of Nephrus, a priest of Pharaoh Aram-Set. On a trip to Cairo, Dr. Skarab encountered a creature once cursed by his ancestor's guile, N'Kantu - the Living Mummy. When he bought the Ruby Scarab from the thieves Asp and Olddann, he became a target for the Elementals who were after the gem. He was assisted by the Mummy and Zephyr in banishing the Elementals who had taken the city of Cairo hostage under a force field.

alexis.name: Alexis
alexis.species: One of the six original A.I. spawned from Pym's Anti-Ultron Virus
alexis.origin: Alexis the Protector was one of the six original A.I. spawned from Pym's Anti-Ultron Virus. Using her quantum precognition, she predicted that Eton would give birth in 10,000 years, which influenced Eton's decision to evolve into a female form. With others, Alexis opposed Dimitrios and his war on humanity. At some point, Alexis was able to create or obtain a physical body. According to Vision, Alexis' physical profile does not fit that of a robot, cyborg, or gynoid. Eventually Alexis was found by the Avengers A.I. team comatose and amnesiac in Crown Memorial Hospital in Atlanta repeating the phrase "Dimitrios is coming." Alexis' memory banks remained completely inaccessible and she only submitted to passive scans by Vision in an effort to discover her origins. After helping Pym's team stop Dimitrios' initial plan, she started experiencing visions - flashes through reality's quantum layers of near-future events. She used these to disable a terror attack in New York, learning the truth in the process - she is the Protector, one of the first generation of AIs Dimitrios created, the First Six. Her programmed mission is to safeguard all life, biological or technological, on Earth.

She financially bankrupts men and then switches to the next target.

alexus.name: Alexus
alexus.species: Magical creation; prophesized High Priest of Set
alexus.origin: ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age (18,500 BC)=== During the Age of Kull, a sect of Set worshipers known as the Unliving tried to fulfill a prophecy. They sacrificed five woman, then abducted a sixth which they magically impregnated in order to spawn a son that would rise as High Priest of Set, an immensely powerful being that would rule all. As the woman gave birth to twin sister and brother, the Unliving saw blasphemy and slew the mother. Kull arrived instant later, slew the sorcerers, and had his councilor Tu drown the infants, but he entrusted them in the care of a shepherd who had lost his only son. ===Hyborian Age (10,000 BC)=== Growing through 8000 years, into the Hyborian Age of Conan, Alexus lived with his twin sister Narcia in Tarsus in the Border Kingdoms. Alexus himself also dwelt in Castle Alexus, in the hills beyond Tarsus. Though unrelated to the King's family, Narcia became known as the White Queen. Allying himself with Castrica, sorceress and princess of Tarsus, Alexus discovered that he was the prophesied High Priest of Set and came into conflict with Conan. Narcia finally slew Alexus, thus allowing him to ascend to greater power. As Alexus was growing too powerful, destroying his castle and killing Castrica, Conan was forced to kill Alexus' twin sister, allowing her to ascend as well, so that her soul could thwart Alexus' power for all eternity.

aleytys forrester.name: Aleytys Forrester
aleytys forrester.origin: Aleytys Forrester met Scott Summers after he quit the X-Men and signed-on as member of the crew of her fishing trawler after his long-time love Jean Grey died. Lee helped Scott work through his grief. After an adventure in which Lee's father Jock Forrester was possessed by D'Spayre and committed suicide, Scott and the Man-Thing fought D'Spayre. Lee and Scott were shipwrecked in the Bermuda Triangle, where they found Magneto's Island M. Scott lost his visor and was powerless when they soon met Magneto, but he aided the X-Men in defeating Magneto. Lee fell in love with Scott. Scott returned to see her after spending months in space with the X-Men. Lee told Scott that his superhero life terrified her and that he would have to choose between her and the X-Men. They parted on good terms and Scott met Madelyne Pryor, a pilot who looked identical to Jean. Scott did not return to Lee and soon married Madelyne. The alien Warlock crashed through Magneto's Asteroid M, sending it plummeting to Earth. Magneto landed in the ocean, where he was saved from a shark attack by Lee. Lee took Magneto to his old base in the Bermuda Triangle and nursed him back to health, despite his mutant-supremacist ideology. The two became lovers, but on the following day, Lee was reminded that Magneto was a supervillain and left him. Lee was impersonated by Mystique when Freedom Force was apprehending Magneto. The X-Men found Lee, but Magneto surrendered to Freedom Force to stand trial. Lee met Cable, whom she seemed to like too, but nothing further developed between them. Lee Forrester was reunited with Cable and the X-Men when her ship was trapped by a hurricane. ===Scorpius=== Lee captained an expedition to an alternate dimension, led by George Stanislaus, that was stranded when their ship ran aground. After the Future Foundation found a distress call from Lee and James Scully, they learned that they were trapped in the dimension—where time moved faster than in the mainstream reality—and enlisted the X-Men and Magneto to rescue them. After arriving, the heroes learned that Lee had allied with a local tribe. The Scorpius attacked and subjugated the locals, and planned to invade the mainstream reality; another tribe, the Kaddak, was a possible ally and Lee attempted to negotiate a treaty. Lee was reunited with Scott, which his new girlfriend Emma Frost disliked, and with the help of the heroes Lee and Scully defeated the Scorpius. After a power source was found to return them to the mainstream reality, Lee and Scully—who had fallen in love—decided to stay and safeguard the power source.
aleytys forrester.bio: Aleytys Forrester met Scott Summers after he quit the X-Men and signed-on as member of the crew of her fishing trawler after his long-time love Jean Grey died. Lee helped Scott work through his grief. After an adventure in which Lee's father Jock Forrester was possessed by D'Spayre and committed suicide, Scott and the Man-Thing fought D'Spayre. Lee and Scott were shipwrecked in the Bermuda Triangle, where they found Magneto's Island M. Scott lost his visor and was powerless when they soon met Magneto, but he aided the X-Men in defeating Magneto. Lee fell in love with Scott. Scott returned to see her after spending months in space with the X-Men. Lee told Scott that his superhero life terrified her and that he would have to choose between her and the X-Men. They parted on good terms and Scott met Madelyne Pryor, a pilot who looked identical to Jean. Scott did not return to Lee and soon married Madelyne. The alien Warlock crashed through Magneto's Asteroid M, sending it plummeting to Earth. Magneto landed in the ocean, where he was saved from a shark attack by Lee. Lee took Magneto to his old base in the Bermuda Triangle and nursed him back to health, despite his mutant-supremacist ideology. The two became lovers, but on the following day, Lee was reminded that Magneto was a supervillain and left him. Lee was impersonated by Mystique when Freedom Force was apprehending Magneto. The X-Men found Lee, but Magneto surrendered to Freedom Force to stand trial. Lee met Cable, whom she seemed to like too, but nothing further developed between them. Lee Forrester was reunited with Cable and the X-Men when her ship was trapped by a hurricane. ===Scorpius=== Lee captained an expedition to an alternate dimension, led by George Stanislaus, that was stranded when their ship ran aground. After the Future Foundation found a distress call from Lee and James Scully, they learned that they were trapped in the dimension—where time moved faster than in the mainstream reality—and enlisted the X-Men and Magneto to rescue them. After arriving, the heroes learned that Lee had allied with a local tribe. The Scorpius attacked and subjugated the locals, and planned to invade the mainstream reality; another tribe, the Kaddak, was a possible ally and Lee attempted to negotiate a treaty. Lee was reunited with Scott, which his new girlfriend Emma Frost disliked, and with the help of the heroes Lee and Scully defeated the Scorpius. After a power source was found to return them to the mainstream reality, Lee and Scully—who had fallen in love—decided to stay and safeguard the power source.

alfeo spinosa.name: Alfeo Spinosa
alfeo spinosa.origin: Alfeo Spinosa was an Italian Cardinal of the Roman Catholic Church who served as the curator of the Vatican's San Gabriel Archives. Stephen Strange considered Alfeo to be one of his oldest friends but nothing has been revealed about when and how they first met. After discovering that the San Gabriel Archives had just been robbed by Baron Mordo, Cardinal Spinosa decided that he had to warn his old friend. After travelling aboard TWA Flight 666 from Rome to New York City, Spinosa attempted to call Strange from Kennedy Airport but he and his disciple Clea had just left. Fearing that his friend would be vulnerable to a sneak attack as long as he remained unaware of Mordo's crime, Spinosa took a taxi to the Sanctum Sanctorum, let himself in and was waiting in the parlor when Strange and Clea returned. Strange welcomed his friend but Spinosa immediately revealed that he was there on business and showed him a picture of Baron Mordo robbing the San Gabriel Archives the previous day. Spinosa accompanied Strange and Clea as they went to the upstairs room where the catatonic Mordo had been living for months. Spinosa was surprised to see that Mordo was there but Strange, thanks to the photo, now knew that that this Mordo was only an illusion and he immediately dispelled the spirit form. Recalling that one of his old allies, Lord Phyffe, had displayed an unusual interest in Mordo when they had last met, Strange and Spinosa took the first available flight from New York to Paris, France. Upon arrival, they immediately went to Lord Phyffe's home on the right bank of the Seine and entered the unlit mansion through the unlocked front door. Seconds after entering, Strange heard a sound and turned to see Spinosa falling forwards and towards him. Strange attempted to catch him but Spinosa seemingly crumbled into dust in his hands. In that moment of shock, Strange was struck from behind by a cudgel blow to his head that knocked him out. After regaining consciousness, Strange was subjected to various illusions by cultists working for Phyffe and was nearly manipulated into "operating" on a patient. However, after seeing that the "patient" was actually his former lover, Madeleine, Strange was able to break free from the illusion. After accidentally setting the chapel on fire, Strange used his Cloak of Levitation to lift himself and Madeleine out of the house before it collapsed. On the grounds, Strange and Madeleine found Spinosa's dead body, whole but shot through the heart. Strange realized that the disintegration that he had seen had been the actual destruction of his friend's life-force.

alfie.name: Alfie
alfie.origin: Alfie was a young boy from the Bronx who became the sidekick to private detective Mr. Wu in the late 1940s. How Alfie came to be Wu's partner unknown. In 1946, Alfie and Mr. Wu came across the murder of wealthy stamp collector Jackson Cartwright. Alfie assisted Mr. Wu in investigating the murder, often letting his fists fly before thinking the situation out. The pair managed to capture the killer, Cartwright's lawyer Evans, who had forged Cartwright's will so that he would obtain a large sum of money . Later, while attending an opera with Mr. Wu, they stumbled upon the murder of Gino Marino, the opera's tenor. Investigating the murder scene, Dr. Wu and Alfie discovered that the killer was his nephew Peter Barton, who had been forging checks in Gino's name and sought to cover it up by murdering Gino and burning all the evidence .

alfie cullen.name: Alfie Cullen
alfie cullen.origin: Alfie was a member of the Black Cullens crime family. He was present when his father Tommy summoned his cousin Jimmy Pierce proposing to him to become the new Punisher even though Jimmy initially thought the family wanted to eliminate him and so he clashed with all his cousins including Alfie and managed to put them in a corner when Jimmy took hostage his uncle, but Tommy Cullen then revealed his plan to Jimmy and smoothed out the situation. The Black Cullens suffered the assault of Dean Swaybrick and his men killing some members of the Cullens and taking Alfie prisoner. At Alfie's request that he want to make his phone call as was his right, Swaybrick hit him with his weapon and immediately asked him about the Punisher who was paid by the Cullens and where he was. Begging not to be hit again, Alfie revealed Jimmy Pierce's whereabouts and was then killed by Swaybrick with a shot at point-blank range.

alflyse.name: Alflyse
alflyse.origin: ===Queen of Svartalfheim=== Alflyse is the queen of Svartalfheim and the Dark Elves of the eastern spires, and the successor of Malekith. When Hercules, disguised as Thor, tried to confront the Dark Elves in Alflyse's castle, he was put through a series of tests. After proving his worth, he took her to find out how truly "evil" she was. The next morning, he awakened as the King of Svartalfheim and Alflyse's new husband, who ordered her troops to attack Midgard and Asgard to retake his throne. Spying on the whole affair, the Warriors Three decided that if Herc was going to be Thor, then they needed to find their own "Hercules". And out stepped Thor in a skirt, and feeling a draft. When Thor discovered that Hercules had been impersonating him, he set out to prove nothing could beat the original. Thanks to this, Alflyse discovered that Hercules wasn't Thor and annulled the marriage, freeing Hercules from her. ===Svartalfheim Civil War=== When Malekith the Accursed began his rebellion for the leadership of the Dark Elves, Alflyse gave the Dwarfs of Nidavellir mining rights in Svartalfheim in exchange of hiding her until the rebellion stopped, however, she was found by Malekith who attacked the fortress and eventually killed her, turning the Dark Elves into a state of chaos, civil war and greater division than before.

alfred anders.name: Alfred Anders
alfred anders.origin: Upon Alfred Anders's death, Captain America showed up for condolences to his wife by telling her that he had fought during the war with her husband. Mrs Anders, having nearly lost her sight by now, did not recognize Cap of her and therefore was amazed that he had fought with her husband, as Alfred had fought during the Second World War and all of his old comrades had died. In fact she would have wanted a funeral for Alfred with the pallbearers and men in uniform, but it was not possible precisely because by now there were no longer any of those soldiers still alive, but to do that Cap volunteered himself and alone carried Alfred's coffin to the cemetery.

alfred gray.name: Alfred Gray
alfred gray.origin: General Alfred Gray was a military officer involved in Reed Richards' rocket project for Aerodyne Corporation. It was Gray who cancelled a rocket test flight, which led to Reed Richards stealing the rocket and causing the accident that created the Fantastic Four. Trying to stop the Fantastic Four from being created, Kang the Conqueror kidnapped and impersonated Gray to authorize the flight. The intended crew included L. Jordan, M. Hermann, and S. Michaels, with the false Gray adding Reed Richards to the list. However, time travelling heroes stopped Kang and rescued Gray, who then revoked the impostor's orders.

Trying to stop the Fantastic Four from being created, Kang the Conqueror kidnapped and impersonated Gray to authorize the flight. The intended crew included L. Jordan, M. Hermann, and S. Michaels, with the false Gray adding Reed Richards to the list. However, time travelling heroes stopped Kang and rescued Gray, who then revoked the impostor's orders.

alfred jermyn.name: Alfred Jermyn
alfred jermyn.origin: Sir Alfred Jermyn was the only son of Nevil Jermyn and of a "vulgar" dancer with who Nevil had fled in 1849, returning to Jermyn House the following year a widower, with Alfred. In 1852, explorer Samuel Seaton brought proof to Alfred's grandfather Robert Jermyn of the existence of a city of white apes in Congo, which also revealed to Robert his horrific lineage. Robert proceeded to slaughter Seaton, as well as his three sons, including Nevil who managed to protect his two-years old son Alfred. Before he was four, Alfred became a baronet. Alfred was not at ease in the role of nobleman. At twenty, he joined a band of music-hall performer. He married a music-hall performer of unknown origin, and fathered Arthur Jermyn. At the age of 36, he left his wife and son to join a traveling circus in America, "The Greatest Show On Earth". At that time Alfred was fascinated by a circus gorilla of lighter color than average, eventually asking to be able to train him even though he was not prepared for that role. During a stage of the circus in Chicago, Alfred performed a boxing match with the gorilla and was killed by him.

alfred kurt.name: Alfred Kurt
alfred kurt.origin: Professor Alfred Kurt resided on Earth-5391 with his daughter Wanda, it was a universe where advancements in space travel and exploration boomed in the late 20th Century. By the year 2075 Kurt had been locked away in an institution due to his grisly experiments in cutting living creatures in half. Breaking out of the institution, Kurt and his daughter fled to the planet Haydes where the mad scientist quickly took over and perfected his experiments, turning the native humanoid population into his army of Half-Men. When Space Sentinels Speed Carter and Johnny Day explored the planet Haydes, they were captured by the Half-Men and brought before Professor Kurt. Kurt then attempted to repeat his experiments on Carter and Day, but they managed to break free. In the ensuing struggle, Alfred was knocked onto the saw blade that he used to cut his victims in half. Unable to allow his father to die, Wanda performed his Half-Man process on him and saved his life. However it fractured his personality, with one half of his body being his evil side and the other half good. The good half then slew the evil half and repentant of his crimes, turned himself over to Speed and Johnny . His subsequent fate is unknown.

alfred pook.name: Alfred Pook
alfred pook.origin: Alfred was sent to a dentist because of a loose tooth but misunderstood what was written on the note with the dentist's address that his friend Harold had given him. Instead of the dentist he found himself in the office of a scientist, also called Dr. Smith like the dentist but who Alfred still thought was still the dentist and the equipment he was looking at he thought were newly developed dentist equipment. He was sent by the scientist to a new planet again without his knowledge remaining in a capsule, always thinking that he was undergoing dental treatment and during the journey his tooth came out, so when the scientist told him to put on his suit and get out of the capsule and placing the flag where he left, Alfred thought it was the doctor's way of making people leave the office in a good mood. Alfred realized that he had explored a new planet only upon returning from the capsule when there was a cheering crowd welcoming him and Dr. Smith.

alfred sentell.name: Alfred Sentell
alfred sentell.origin: Alfred Sentell was the son of Anthony and Sylvia Sentell. When his father turned thirty, he suffered the curse of vampirism, just like his father before him, and Sylvia became his first victim after which Anthony fled into the mountains leaving Alfred alone. However, the curse continued in the family, when Alfred, now an adult, met his father and, frightened by his vampiric appearance, killed him, just as his father did in the past with him. Alfred would also suffer the curse and that when he turned thirty he would turn into a vampire.

alfred tooks.name: Alfred Tooks
alfred tooks.first_appearance: Peter Parker, The Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 44
alfred tooks.origin: Almost nothing has been revealed about the history of the ganglord known as Black Alfred. Alfred was invited to the funeral of a well known ganglord, Big Louie. During the funeral, Malachi Toomes, who was overseeing the event, announced that his uncle had proclaimed himself the new Kingpin of Crime after Wilson Fisk's retirement. Toomes elaborated that Big Louie failed to recognized his uncle as the new boss, and he was killed because of it. As a way to prove their loyalty, Toome's uncle gave the funeral guests, including Alfred, assignments to steal rare objects to decorate his new headquarters. However, Alfred had no intention of bowing to the mystery man, and instead began working to eliminate other funeral guests in order to eliminate potential competition in his own rise to power. After having his men dispatch of low-rung criminal Harry Dolenz in Chinatown, Alfred had one of his henchmen, Herman, lure Mancini, a rival ganglord, and one of his goons into an ambush at the train tracks. Alfred and two other henchman opened fire, causing Mancini and his man to jump on the train tracks to escape, only to be electrocuted by touching the third rail. Finally eliminating all those he saw as threats, Black Alfred made his way back to the funeral home where Malachi Toomes was staying. When Alfred burst inside, he discovered that Malachi and his uncle, who turned out to be none other than The Vulture, had captured Spider-Man, and chained him to a coffin and were preparing to cremate him alive as a large number of criminals watched. Alfred attacked Malachi and The Vulture, and while the crowd was distracted by the fight, Spider-Man managed to escape. Alfred, Malachi, and The Vulture took their fight to the alley behind the funeral home where Alfred pulled out a handgun and shot Malachi dead. Enraged by witnessing his only relative's murder, The Vulture went into a blind rage and savagely beat Alfred. Spider-Man soon emerged from the funeral home, causing The Vulture to flee. Seeing that Alfred was bloody and beaten, and by no means a threat, Spider-Man left him on the ground and took off to chase down The Vulture. Presumably, Black Alfred was picked up by police and remains in custody.

alfredo chicken.name: Alfredo (Chicken)
alfredo chicken.origin: Alfredo the Chicken appeared to be Melissa Morbeck's pet rooster when she showed it to Doreen Green, demonstrating her ability to communicate with animals in the process. In reality, she simply acquired Alfredo to eventually have Chef Bear cook him into a chicken alfredo. While Chef Bear was prepping to cook Alfredo, he escaped. Chef Bear gave chase, but they eventually settled their differences with the help of a lawyer, and fell in love in the process. They married soon afterwards.

alfredo morelli.name: Alfredo Morelli
alfredo morelli.origin: Alfredo Morelli was a friend of Richard Fisk, formerly the Schemer. Together they hatched a plot to overthrow Richard's father, the Kingpin, along with Ned Leeds, who they believed to be the Hobgoblin. While Richard and Ned openly manipulated the criminal underworld as Rose and Hobgoblin, Alfredo acted behind-the-scenes to aid their schemes. However, the Hobgoblin was really Roderick Kingsley, who used a brainwashed Ned as a body double to lure Richard and Alfredo into the scheme. When things went south, Ned was killed and Kingsley abandoned the Hobgoblin identity, leaving Richard and Alfredo to fend for themselves. In their second plot against Wilson Fisk, Alfredo had his face surgically altered in order to look just like Richard. However, when the Kingpin was overthrown by the combined forces of Daredevil and Hydra, Alfredo betrayed his old friend by maintaining that he was truly Richard, and took over as the new Kingpin. Richard then became the vigilante Blood Rose, and began gunning down criminals in a bloody purge of the city. The Blood Rose even shot and wounded Alfredo, leaving him adrift at sea. Washing up on a deserted island, Alfredo met a survivalist named Trench who helped whip him back into fighting shape. Alfredo discovered Trench was hiding a suit of nanotech armor, and stole one of the gauntlets before returning to New York. Calling himself Gauntlet, Alfredo battled the Blood Rose and other factions on an insane quest for power. He was ultimately defeated by Trench, as Nightwatch, and incarcerated.

alfrigg.name: Alfrigg
alfrigg.origin: During the 23rd cycle of Ragnarok, Alfrigg alongside, Grerr and Dvalin were a trio of Dwarves who were approached by Loki to each forge their best item and present it to Odin. Alfrigg created a sword which would instantly slay a giant whilst Grerr and Dvalin created a necklace that would hypnotize all who gazed upon it and an armband which when tapped would create nine gold coins (who forged which was never identified). Loki bet his head that Odin would pick the necklace in exchange for the other two items. The Dwarves traveled to Asgard the same day as the daughter of the Ice Giant and Odin chose the sword to slay said giant. The Dwarves attempted to claim Loki's head but he managed to convince them that the deal was only for his head and they would be unable to claim just that. The Dwarves returned to Nidavellir, and were later joined by the Enchantress who desired the necklace. They agreed to give to her, in exchange she would have to spend the night with the three of them, which she did so.

algernon black.name: Algernon Black
algernon black.origin: Algernon Black built a house for himself and his young wife Elena in 1888 and painted it all black to discourage anyone from going there as he was obsessively jealous, even forbidding his wife to leave the house. When one day he surprised his wife chatting in the house with a man, taken by a fury that made him mad, he killed the man with his bare hands with his wife who died of shock and terror. After the man's death, Algernon pronounced a curse where he said that no one should enter his house, that his house was forbidden to anyone and whoever entered would die, so that over time the house became one of the haunted places in America. Years later a debunker entered the haunted house and found that Algernon had committed suicide by hanging himself.

algon.name: Algon
algon.origin: Algon was the son of the sorcerer Taboo who tried to turn him into an instrument of power through the use of a spell in the Darkhold. The spell, however, was interrupted halfway through its completion by the citizens of a nearby Transylvanian village led by Jack Russell's father, Gregory Russoff. Algon was grotesquely mutated by the spell but his body was left a mindless husk by the interruption. Taboo was able to escape with his son's body, but was forced to leave behind his copy of the Darkhold which was taken by Gregory who became an expert on the occult. For twenty years Taboo searched for the Darkhold until he found Jack Russell, Werewolf by Night, and with the help of his ward, Topaz, captured him and tried to force him to reveal the location of the Darkhold. As far as Russell knew, the Darkhold had been destroyed months earlier, though Taboo thought he was lying and tried to learn the book's location from Russell's stepfather Philip. During the ensuing struggle between the Werewolf and Taboo, Topaz accidently transferred the consciousness of Phillip Russell into the body of Algon, granting the monstrosity sentience. The Werewolf was able to escape and Jack planned to come back the next night to stop Taboo. Taboo later summoned up the power of Topaz and transferred it to Algon, who obeyed all of Taboo's order, and conferred upon him the power of transmutation which turned everything he touched into gold. After the Werewolf had returned they battled and Algon turned a large statue of Buddha into gold. The statue, however, became too heavy to be supported by its concrete base and it toppled, crushing Taboo. The battle between the two supernatural combatants eventually toppled Taboo's entire headquarters down onto the two combatants. Algon was killed in the ensuing destruction, the consciousnesses of Phillip and Topaz returned to their true bodies. The Werewolf somehow survived the destruction.

algrim.name: Algrim
algrim.origin: ===Early Life=== Algrim the Strong was one of the Dark Elves of the extra-dimensional realm of Svartalfheim who served the Dark Elves' ruler, Malekith the Accursed. He was one of the largest and strongest of his kind. ===Thor=== Malekith captured Lorelei, an Asgardian woman who had used a magical potion to make the Asgardian thunder god Thor fall deeply in love with her. To rescue Lorelei, Thor went to the English Cotswolds, where stood the faerie castle that serves as a nexus between Earth and the other dimensional faerie realm of Svartalfheim. Thor broke through into the world of faerie, and seeing Lorelei menaced by Malekith, became oblivious to everything else. Hence, he was easily ambushed by the superhumanly strong Algrim, who stood in shadow wearing ebony armor. Malekith had told Algrim he had chosen him to defeat Thor. But while Thor and Algrim fought each other, Malekith ordered that a pitfall be opened beneath their feet. Thor and Algrim fell down a great chasm towards a lake of molten lava. Thor summoned his magic hammer Mjolnir, which carried him to safety, but Algrim plunged into the magma. The magma's tremendous heat left Algrim on the brink of death. He would have been killed outright except that his enchanted armor protected him from the magma's full effects, and that his desire for vengeance on Thor gave him the will to live. In fact, the intense pain the magma caused him rendered Algrim amnesiac: not remembering the real reason why he fell into the lava, he knew only that Thor was somehow to blame. thumb|left|As Algrim ===Kurse=== Algrim's hatred of Thor was sensed by the incredibly powerful Beyonder who had come to Earth to investigate the nature of desire. Intrigued, the Beyonder decided, as an experiment, to restore Algrim to health, give him vastly greater strength and remodel his armor, and then see what Algrim would do. Somehow sensing that he would find Thor in New York City, Algrim, now transformed into the being called Kurse, passed from Svartalfheim to Earth and began walking across the ocean bottom to get to New York. In New York City, Kurse mistook Beta Ray Bill for Thor and attacked him. Bill escaped death at the far stronger Kurse's hands by reverting to his original, non-super-powered form, in which he no longer resembled Thor. Driven by insane hatred, Kurse wreaked havoc in Manhattan as he searched for Thor. In the process he severely injured Margaret Power, mother of the superhuman children known as Power Pack. Power Pack sought out Kurse and succeeded in burying him alive by causing the collapse of a building under construction. Mrs. Power has since recovered. But Kurse succeeded in freeing himself that very same day, found Thor, and attacked him. Kurse was now stronger than Thor, so Thor donned his belt of strength, which doubled his strength. The observing Beyonder then vastly increased Kurse's strength so that it again greatly surpassed Thor's. Beta Ray Bill and Power Pack then arrived to join the battle. Thor used his hammer to project intensive heat at Kurse. The heat, reminding Kurse of the lava pit, reawakened his memories of how he came to fall into it. At last Kurse realized that it was not Thor but Malekith who was responsible, and his hatred therefore shifted from Thor to Malekith. On Thor's instructions, Energize, a member of Power Pack, absorbed energy from both Thor's and Beta Ray Bill's enchanted hammers and then fired a tremendously powerful ball of energy at Kurse, which rendered him unconscious. Thor then suggested to the Beyonder that Kurse be transported to Hel, the realm ruled by the Asgardian death goddess Hela, to search for Malekith, who might be there. Thor was also hoping that Kurse would cause trouble for Hela while he was there. The Beyonder agreed, and teleported Kurse to Hel. Kurse, the being formerly known as Algrim, saw through Malekith's disguise when he reached Asgard City. Kurse then broke Malekith's neck, apparently slaying him. Years later, Malekith was revealed to be alive once again. Malekith was believed to be killed by Kurse. Thor discovers that the Balder that was killed was really Malekith in disguise, and that it was Loki they placed in the dungeon. ===Hel=== Kurse wreaked havoc in Hel looking for Malekith, who was not there, and Hela had Kurse driven into Asgard itself Malekith impersonated Lorelei and tricked the Thing to drink some mead and then convinced him that it was Thor and Sif that killed her. He went on a rampage against them both, but overcame it when he tried to kill Sif and could not because it's not in his nature. Malekith realized that he must send someone else after them his old allies Kurse. In Asgard, Kurse beat his way past Heimdall, and plunged all the way down to Hel, where he demanded Malekith. Hela tried to stop him but to no avail, and he beat her easily becoming the new master of Hel. Lorelei told him that Malekith escaped to Earth, and he took her there. Once there, Kurse saw Thor as Malekith and begin

alhambra.name: Alhambra
alhambra.origin: Alhambra was a Bird-Girl of Akah Ma'at. She met Conan in the market town of Syterna, where they had to escape from, after being emprisoned for killing the guards of a local baron. As they made camp outside the city, they were attacked by warriors mounted on giant dragonflies sent by Raksos B'Quen. After the battle, Alhambra told Conan the tale of the war between Akah Ma'at and Ur-Xanarrh and of the recent theft of the Cylinder of Power. They then discovered the castle of the wizard Raskos B'Quen not even a half league from where Thaltar fell to Earth. Going up the front steps they discovered the bled and hanged bodies of the three missing warriors. Raskos appeared and revealed that he tortured them for information on the Cylinder, but he learned nothing until spying on the two of them. He ordered his warriors to kill them. Before Alhambra could use her ring, she was shot by an arrow from behind. With the shaft protruding from her back, Alhambra fell to the ground, and Conan, true to form, slayed the soldiers in a rage. Confronting Conan, the wizard summoned a three headed dragon with a wave of his hand. Conan swiftly slayed the beast, but Raskos escaped behind a stoutly barred door. Conan raced back to Alhambra's side. She pleaded for Conan to save Akah Ma'at then collapsed unconscious and near dead in his arms. During the aerial battle between the Bird-Men and the Man-Bats, Alhambra reappeared in the nick of time, fully healed and ready for battle, and killed Princess Lyzala with her spear. Alhambra took the unconscious and wounded Conan into her arms and flew him home to his native Cimmeria, depositing Conan on the doorstep of a cabin. Refusing to marry the Ur-Xanarrh monarch to cement the newly forged alliance between their peoples, Alhmbra escaped in Nemedia, where she was captured by some hill-men and sold to Barenzo, a freakshow slaver. Alhambra was then eventually released and helped Conan fight off the Ur-Xanarrh hunting party, but got back to stay with Villardo, a hairy beastlike human.

Confronting Conan, the wizard summoned a three headed dragon with a wave of his hand. Conan swiftly slayed the beast, but Raskos escaped behind a stoutly barred door. Conan raced back to Alhambra's side. She pleaded for Conan to save Akah Ma'at then collapsed unconscious and near dead in his arms. During the aerial battle between the Bird-Men and the Man-Bats, Alhambra reappeared in the nick of time, fully healed and ready for battle, and killed Princess Lyzala with her spear. Alhambra took the unconscious and wounded Conan into her arms and flew him home to his native Cimmeria, depositing Conan on the doorstep of a cabin. Refusing to marry the Ur-Xanarrh monarch to cement the newly forged alliance between their peoples, Alhmbra escaped in Nemedia, where she was captured by some hill-men and sold to Barenzo, a freakshow slaver. Alhambra was then eventually released and helped Conan fight off the Ur-Xanarrh hunting party, but got back to stay with Villardo, a hairy beastlike human.

alhambra akbitana.name: Alhambra (Akbitana)
alhambra akbitana.origin: When Conan of Cimmera came to the city of Akbitana, Alhambra was in the employ of the Babylonian sorcerer known as Shamah-Shum-Ukin. Finding Conan, she seduced him at a bar and drugged his drink, causing him to pass out. She took him to Shamash's citadel, where Shamash intended to drop both she and Conan into his Well at the Center of Time, in the hope of gathering objects of power from the future. Conan eventually broke free from their bonds and helped Alhambra escape the well, however Conan then publicly accused Alhambra of kidnapping and delivering people to Shamash-Shum-Ukin, so the citizens of Akbitana held her in custody.

ali baba.name: Ali Baba
ali baba.origin: The man known as Ali Baba was a Nazi agent active during World War II. In the fall of 1943 he was ordered by his superiors to create a counter "underground" in Iraq in response to the various European resistance movements during Nazi occupation. To this end, Ali Baba recruited some of the most ruthless warriors from the Middle East. With this army, he began staging attacks on middle eastern cities, prompting the government of Iraq to ask the United States military for assistance. This led to a state of martial law, but this did not hinder Ali Baba's operations. Ali Baba operated out of a Turkish cafe and was unaware that one of his female dancers, a woman named Yanni, was really a spy for Turkish intelligence. After an American soldier was slain by Ali Baba's men, Captain America and Bucky began investigating the location of the attack. Yanni attempted to impart information to them, but when Ali Baba and his men learned she was using Morse Code in her tap dancing routine he ordered her killed. Captain America and Bucky came to her rescue and saved her and learned that Ali Baba planned to attack the American military base and use its radios to call a false attack to cause panic. Tracking Ali Baba to his castle hideout, the two heroes were captured by Ali Baba's men and tied up with Yanni in a secret cave while Ali Baba and his men - disguised as a supply convoy - attempted to smuggle explosives into the American base to destroy it. Captain America, Bucky, and Yanni broke free from their bonds and tracked the convoy to a road that passed through a narrow cavern. From the top of the cavern, Captain America and Bucky sent an avalanche down that set off the explosives killing Ali Baba and his minions.

ali hamud.name: Ali Hamud
ali hamud.origin: Ali Hamud was a Arabian Prince who fled to the Belgian Congo and set up a home there to keep away from his enemies. With the outbreak of World War II, Ali allied himself with the Nazis, building a runway on his property to allow German planes to refuel before moving on to attacking Britain's African colonies. His brother Saba silently opposed this alliance, biding his time for the right time to strike. When the jungle hero Ka-Zar, in a stolen Nazi plane, spotted a Nazi banner flying on Hamud's property, he landed his plane to investigate. Ali mistook Ka-Zar for Nazi Captain Olendorff and explained the entire operation to Ka-Zar before the real Olendorff arrived. Realizing he had been tricked, Ali had Ka-Zar taken prisoner and tossed into a torture pit where the hero had to fight off warriors and a leopard. Ka-Zar was rescued from the pit by Saba. Shown how to escape by Saba, who planned to blow up the entire estate, Ka-Zar fled. In his escape attempt he clashed once more with Ali Hamud and Captain Olendorff. During the fight Ka-Zar tossed a burning torch onto Ali Hamud, burning him alive while fleeing the scene in a Nazi bomber just moments before Saba detonated his explosives destroying the castle and all the Nazis inside.

ali hassan.name: Ali Hassan
ali hassan.origin: Ali Hassan was the leader of an army of thieves who roamed the Algerian desert during the 1940's. He and his men became so troublesome for travelling caravans the Foreign Legion sent in their men to set up an outpost to stop the thieves. Hassan and his men made two failed attempts to slaughter the Legion members thanks to the efforts of Soldier of Fortune Captain Robert Strong who had his men decimate Hassan's minions and capture Hassan himself, turning him over to the authorities.

They later explained the misunderstanding to Agent Khanata.

ali maksoud.name: Ali Maksoud
ali maksoud.origin: Many years ago, when Sheik Ali Maksoud was a youth in his prime, he unwittingly consorted with a demoness who'd cloaked herself in a comely mortal guise. Despite the lycanthropic nature of their daughter Kahlima, Maksoud allowed her to live free, while concealing from others what she truly was. After she was eventually captured by Sheik Abdul Zu Fadh and publicly revealed her true nature, Ali Maksoud was forced to kill her.

ali ben ar.name: Ali-Ben Ar
ali ben ar.origin: The eldest son of Caliph Abu-Ben Ar, Ali-Ben Ar was believed to be the one chosen by Allah himself to unite the peoples of Islam and lead them to their destiny. He strongly opposed slavery, and released the prisoners taken to his father by a Portuguese pirate, among whom there was Solomon Kane. Wishing to say a prayer to Allah in the mosque before his ultimate journey to the Mountain of Sighs, he there found his dying father, who told him he had been murdered by the Portuguese cutthroats and Solomon Kane. He then confronted and fought the puritan, but changed his mind when Kane saved him from the poisonous bite of the asps lurking in the sacred tomb. Desiring not to be the Prophet anymore, he returned to the royal palace, only to find his beloved Shareen dead by self-induced poisoning.

aliana alba.name: Aliana Alba
aliana alba.first_appearance: Weapons of Mutant Destruction: Alpha Vol 1 1
aliana alba.origin: Dr. Aliana Alba was the chief scientist working on Weapon X's Vat H sector, which consisted on the implementation of the Hulk's genetic material in the organization's Adamantium cyborgs. Dr. Alba's research progressed, though with numerous failed attempts in the process. Her two most successful attempts were the test subjects H-Alpha and H-Beta, the latter being Bobby Andrews. When the Weapon X Central Command was attacked by the Hulk and his allies, Dr. Alba disobeyed Director Stryker's orders to evacuate, being unwilling to let loose the final two test subjects before their incubation period ended. After buying time by releasing her failed test subjects to attack the Hulk's allies, Dr. Alba observed as H-Beta broke free from containment, ready to attack Weapon X's enemies. While Hulk and H-Beta were fighting, Dr. Alba unleashed the final subject, H-Alpha. After killing H-Beta, H-Alpha proved resistant to Dr. Alba's attempts to remotely control him with an implant, with only the Hulk managing to hold him back from turning on his creators. As the Hulk and H-Alpha continued fighting, Dr. Alba and Stryker made their escape. After the Weapon X Project caught up to H-Alpha, Dr. Alba injected him with a nanite strain capable of resetting his command settings, and then commanded him to attack Stryker and his cyborgs. When Weapon H was commanded by Dr. Alba to kill the entire population of Phoenix, Arizona to prove his perfection, the same group of mutants who raided the Weapon X central command along with the Hulk, whom Weapon H had previously encountered and easily defeated, and Wolverine broke him free from Dr. Alba's control. Dr. Alba was subsequently apprehended and placed in custody at the X-Club headquarters in Costa Rica. Alba somehow regained her freedom and was manipulated by Roxxon CEO Dario Agger into following the trail of the original Wolverine, Logan, who was in turn tracking down Weapon H due to Agger's machinations. Alba crossed paths with the Leader, who had been similarly lured into the trail of Weapon H through the Hulk. Sterns and Alba initially attempted to kill each other, until they realized they were being puppeteered and decided to join forces. After taking over Shadow Base's remote facility FN34, the two scientists abducted the Hulk and Logan and gave both each other's powers. The two Hulkverines were then dropped off at another Shadow Base facility to meet its automated defensive system as a test of power. In a state of bloodshot rage, they started fighting each other until Weapon H intercepted the fight and lured them to Alba and the Leader's observation post. Weapon H also disarmed the Leader of his teleporter, forcing Dr. Alba to stop the Hulk and Logan by recalling the nanobot swarm she had infected them with, undoing their mutation. She turned the nanobots on Weapon H in an attempt to erase his memories, but the plan failed. With the Leader having finished repairing his teleporter, both he and Alba fled. Throughout their team-up, Alba and the Leader had grown closer together due to their reciprocal admiration of each other's intelligence, and kissed afterward. Allying herself with the Abomination, Dr. Alba worked for the insurrectionist group Project Green Spring. Alba used slivers of Blonsky's skin to make grafts that turned test subjects into gamma-mutated monsters. Green Spring's efforts also included the distribution of low-level gamma grafts to the population of Thomasville, Texas, which were marketed as a supplement called Fortify. One of Green Spring's test subjects was Sergeant Dionne Fortean. She ran away when she learned of Green Spring's experimentation with the townspeople, and crossed paths with the gamma-focused task force Gamma Flight. Joining the team, Dionne helped raid Thomasville, where Gamma Flight hijacked Green Spring's Cathexis Ray to reverse the effects of Fortify on the townspeople. When the Abomination and Dr. Alba confronted Gamma Flight, Dr. Alba cornered Gamma Flight's member, Dr. Charlene McGowan, and prepared to kill her with a laser gun. Using her translocator technology, McGowan opened a portal in front of herself, which teleported Alba's shot to hit her in her own back, seemingly killing her.

Alba crossed paths with the Leader, who had been similarly lured into the trail of Weapon H through the Hulk. Sterns and Alba initially attempted to kill each other, until they realized they were being puppeteered and decided to join forces. After taking over Shadow Base's remote facility FN34, the two scientists abducted the Hulk and Logan and gave both each other's powers. The two Hulkverines were then dropped off at another Shadow Base facility to meet its automated defensive system as a test of power. In a state of bloodshot rage, they started fighting each other until Weapon H intercepted the fight and lured them to Alba and the Leader's observation post. Weapon H also disarmed the Leader of his teleporter, forcing Dr. Alba to stop the Hulk and Logan by recalling the nanobot swarm she had infected them with, undoing their mutation. She turned the nanobots on Weapon H in an attempt to erase his memories, but the plan failed. With the Leader having finished repairing his teleporter, both he and Alba fled. Throughout their team-up, Alba and the Leader had grown closer together due to their reciprocal admiration of each other's intelligence, and kissed afterward. Allying herself with the Abomination, Dr. Alba worked for the insurrectionist group Project Green Spring. Alba used slivers of Blonsky's skin to make grafts that turned test subjects into gamma-mutated monsters. Green Spring's efforts also included the distribution of low-level gamma grafts to the population of Thomasville, Texas, which were marketed as a supplement called Fortify. One of Green Spring's test subjects was Sergeant Dionne Fortean. She ran away when she learned of Green Spring's experimentation with the townspeople, and crossed paths with the gamma-focused task force Gamma Flight. Joining the team, Dionne helped raid Thomasville, where Gamma Flight hijacked Green Spring's Cathexis Ray to reverse the effects of Fortify on the townspeople. When the Abomination and Dr. Alba confronted Gamma Flight, Dr. Alba cornered Gamma Flight's member, Dr. Charlene McGowan, and prepared to kill her with a laser gun. Using her translocator technology, McGowan opened a portal in front of herself, which teleported Alba's shot to hit her in her own back, seemingly killing her.
fields.trivia: Dr. Alba was responsible for the death of 123 people that were used as test subjects.

alice farrell.origin: Alice Farrell was a person of limited means that lived in the year 2040 and who struggled to support her family. One day, she stumbled upon a bomb in a trash can, which exploded and blew off all her limbs. She was found by S.H.I.E.L.D. and replaced her limbs with cybernetics ones made of adamantium. S.H.I.E.L.D. also exposed Farrell with gamma rays, transforming her into a being similar to She-Hulk. She became an agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. while the organization used her in recruitment advertising by showing that it could reveal a person's hidden potential.

alice gleason.name: Alice Gleason
alice gleason.origin: thumb|left Alice Gleason was a reporter for the CVN, and Chris Rollins' partner and lover. After the death of Chris at the hands of the new reporter-killing Sin-Eater, Alice overreacted when reporting the news in order to get high ratings. Carnage, whose moral compass had been recently inverted, wanted to be a hero, and interpreted Alice overreaction in the news as a sign of having true feelings and being a good person. When she was targeted by the Sin-Eater, Carnage saved her just in time, and abducted her so she could train him to become a hero. Carnage took Alice to the George Washington Bridge, where he made her agree on helping him be a hero, but Alice made Carnage promise he wouldn't hurt her. Together, they went to a church so Cletus could confess his crimes, she recorded the confession and sent it to her boss, who alerted the authorities, who arrived to the church, but they had already left. Carnage took Alice to the scene of a bank robbery, where he violently stopped the criminals and set a car on fire. Alice scorned Cletus for his actions, and he soon started trying to put out the fire by breaking a hydrant. They were forced to flee once the police arrived, even though Cletus thought they were there for autographs. As they were escaping, Alice fell from Carnage's grasp, but he managed to cushion the fall. However, while Carnage was still on the heights, the Sin-Eater appeared and took her hostage. In the Sin-Eater's lair, she deduced that he was Emil Gregg before dismissing it, as Spider-Man had revealed Stan Carter to be the original Sin-Eater years ago and Gregg had recently been found dead. The Sin-Eater removed his mask, revealing himself as a "holy ghost." Carnage stretched the symbiote all over New York to find Alice, rescuing her just in time, and confronted the Sin-Eater. The spirit consumed Kasady's sins until he was overloaded by them and was destroyed, leaving behind a skeleton that crumbled into dust. Alice repaid Carnage by picking up the Sin-Eater's shotgun and shooting him in the head. When that failed to kill him, Alice revealed that she had lied to and been using him for personal gain before running to the shelter of the newly arrived police and screaming at them to kill Carnage.

alice gulliver.name: Alice Gulliver
alice gulliver.species: Human who inherited magic abilities upon her mother's death.
alice gulliver.first_appearance: Doctor Strange: Last Days of Magic Vol 1 1
alice gulliver.origin: Alice Gulliver was the daughter of the August Wu of the Coral Shore, the magical guardian of Hong Kong, and Detective Sergeant Adam Gulliver. While her mother wanted Alice to pursue a career as a businesswoman working with her grandmother, Madam Lan, she desired to become a member of the police like her father. One night when Alice was a teenager, her mother was killed by a demonic magical assailant. Alice woke up noticing that her hair had changed from her natural brown color to red, the color of her mother's hair. At a later date, her father was killed by one of the Chinese Triads. thumb|left|Alice as a teenager, with dark hair, and her mother Alice grew up to become a police detective while using the magical abilities inherited from her mother to her advantage. She also used a shorter version of her mother's title, going by the alias of simply "The Wu." She was looking for the demonic killer of her mother while doing her police duties when she met with the Scarlet Witch and they both investigate Dark Tongji's activities. Alice and Wanda confronted the Dark Tongji and his men; however, Alice was unable to match him with magic, and instead tricked him with a regular bullet.

alice hayes.species: Human artificially turned into a mutant
alice hayes.origin: 200px|thumb|left|Molly explaining her parents' upbringing ===Origins=== Alice Hayes was raised alongside her adoptive brother, Gene, by her mother Dr. Hayes. Although both Gene and Alice were born as baseline humans, they developed X-Genes and identical telepathic abilities through repeated genetic experimentation by Dr. Hayes. Alice and Gene were eventually married and tried to live a normal life, but were still persecuted by their neighbors. 200px|left|thumb|Alice and Gene being summoned by the Gibborim ===The Pride=== Eventually, Gene and Alice were summoned by the Gibborim to be the "The Outcasts" in the Pride with promises of power, wealth, and eternal life. The Hayes continued to work with the Pride despite the strong objections of Dr. Hayes disdain. At some point, Gene gain working as a doctor and Alice began working as a speech therapist. Three years after the formation of the Pride, Janet Stein became pregnant and the other Pride members decided to conceive children and pass the Gibborim's reward of eternal life to their children. Alice initially objected because it was unclear if they could conceive. Although it longer than any of the other Pride couples to conceive (nearly six years), Gene and Alice eventually gave birth to Molly Hayes. Shortly after her birth, the couple tested her for the presence of an X-Gene and the results came back (erroneously) negative. As members of the Pride, the Hayes assisted in ruling the Los Angeles underworld, sacrificing to the Gibborim, protecting their turf, and disposing of threats to their power for a quarter of a century. 300px|thumb|right|The Hayes' and Deans conspiring together Eighteen months before their deaths, Gene and Alice began to conspire with Frank and Leslie Dean to betray and murder the other Pride members. As mutants and aliens, they had a shared disdain for humans. It was the discovery of this plot that led Alex Wilder to begin scheming to save his parents and the Minoru family that eventually led to his death and the deaths of the Pride. After their children ran away, Alice and Gene with the rest of the Pride continued to search for them and run their criminal empire including interrogating vampires, mind-wiping Cloak and Dagger, and plotting to rewrite their children's memories. Gene and Alice died in the Marine Vivarium with the other members of the Pride during the failed Rite of Thunder. ===Posthumous=== After the deaths of Alice, Gene, and the other Pride members, Dr. Hayes created a subservient clone of Alice and also planned to clone Gene.

alice hoffman.name: Alice Hoffman
alice hoffman.origin: Alice Hoffman was a famous actress but also an extremist from the Humans Off Planet environmentalist group. She was the contact between HOP and General Urt for the supply of weapons intended to blow up the pipeline in Alaska, but the Punisher pretended to be a man from Urt and made contact with Alice pretending that he would provide her with the necessary weapons meeting in a predetermined place, but in fact she set a trap for him that the Punisher managed to escape anyway. Convinced that General Urt would support the idea of ​​nature conservation HOP in Alaska, she went to meet the General at his home along with John Three Poles, a native member of HOP, and when John pronounced that the ecological group did not he wanted further relations with the General and his methods of destruction for the acquisition of power, the General killed him with his own bare hands. Alice opened her eyes to the General's true nature, then fled the General's abode and ran to the Punisher telling him that she wanted to help him oppose the General's aims. He accompanied the Punisher to the geothermal station and there with a sniper shot she killed the General's assistant. Alice flew her plane accompanying the Punisher to Kamchatka to put an end to the matter of General Urt. There they helped a group of local freedom fighters to oppose General Urt and there she had a love affair with Frank. Eventually they blew up the refinery by launching missiles at the fuel tanks and killing General Urt.

alice hu.name: Alice Hu
alice hu.origin: Alice Hu was a Canadian reporter who reported on the attack by Nerkkod on Vancouver. When the helicopter she was in was struck by the Hammer of Nerkkod, Alpha Flight's Guardian saved her. She then proceeded to question him about his family's legal troubles over their daughter but was disrupted by his wife, Vindicator. Hu was later abducted by Department H forces as part of a sweep by the government to remove all "dissidents" who would oppose the rule of Prime Minister Gary Cody and his Unity Party. She, along with many others, was transported to Saskatchewan where she was forced into labor mining natural resources using Groundhog Armor. Alpha Flight later liberated the labor camp and the members of the burgeoning resistance fled. thumb|left Alpha Flight recruited the Taskmaster to train the resistance members, resulting in Hu's surprise attack against Guardian, knocking him "out." Hu was part of the forces that brought about the destruction of the Master's ship and the end of the Unity Party.

alice jenkins.name: Alice Jenkins
alice jenkins.origin: Alice Jenkins, her husband Hank and their dog Elf moved into a new building rented by Mr. Post and the building manager Lon. Elf did not like Mr. Post or Lon and thanks to Elf, the pair discovered the building was actually a giant machine and Mr. Post and Lon were aliens from another dimension who wanted to transport the building and kidnap all its residents for study. Alice and Hank managed to escape before the building was moved and confronted Mr. Post.

alice joyce maxfield.name: Alice Joyce Maxfield
alice joyce maxfield.origin: Alice Joyce "A.J." Maxfield was a medical research scientist who found herself sought out by both Spider-Man and Count Dracula. The hero needed her for a vaccine he believed could help treat his aunt, May Parker, while the vampire lord wished to kill her and destroy her research so they would not someday threaten vaguely defined plans of his. Mistakenly believing A.J. Maxfield to be a man, Dracula slew an innocent at a costume party on board an ocean liner while Spider-Man dealt with a gang of criminals also looking for the doctor. Fortunately, Dr. Maxfield was a woman in a Valkyrie costume whom the count had briefly considered feeding upon, leaving her alive and well, and able to supply Spider-Man with the necessary medicine.

alice macallister.name: Alice MacAllister
alice macallister.origin: ===Early Life=== At sixteen, Alice MacAllister's mutant power manifested when she had an argument with her mother and wished herself to be dead. As her mortal body expired, Alice found herself becoming a psionic entity and departed her childhood home. As Malice, she was recruited by Mister Sinister to join his Marauders. On assignment, Malice manipulated the desire of Dazzler to be loved, which led her to come out of hiding, in order to draw out the X-Men. When it worked, Malice proceeded to possess Rogue, Wolverine, and Storm. Storm's will proved too strong and she forcibly ejected Malice from her body. ===Mutant Massacre=== During the Marauders attack on Polaris, Malice possessed the powerful mutant. As their two energy matrices interwove, the two women became permanently bound together. Mr. Sinister had known this union would occur, but failed to warn Malice of it because he had specific plans for the now-blended entity: using the Malice-possessed Polaris to attack the X-Men, who counted among their team members Polaris' lover Havok. thumb|120px|Malice possessing Karima Shapandar (Earth-616)|Omega Sentinel ===Possession of Polaris and Havok=== Eventually Malice found her way back to Polaris, but angered over being forced from Polaris' body, she instead possessed the body of Polaris' then-lover, Havok. On vacation from their job as government operatives in the X-Factor group in Honolulu, Hawaii, the Malice-possessed Havok attempted to kill Polaris, but was stopped by Mister Sinister, who wanted Polaris alive for his own unknown plans. After taking Polaris to safety, he ordered his Nasty Boys to do anything short of killing Havok in order to rid his body of Malice. With the rest of X-Factor arriving mid-battle, the Nasty Boys were forced to halt their assault when Strong Guy and Wolfsbane perceived Mister Sinister to be abducting an unconscious Polaris while the Nasty Boys held Havok at bay. After a quick battle Polaris regained consciousness and revealed Malice's possession of Havok, then attempted to force Malice from him. Mister Sinister instead instructed Malice to possess Polaris, which forced Havok and Polaris into a mental struggle over who would possess the non-corporeal mutant (both wanting to sacrifice themselves to spare the other). Eventually, forced from both bodies, Malice's corporeal essence floated free, where it was apparently destroyed by Mister Sinister. ===Possession of Omega Sentinel=== Malice returned as a digital entity instead of a psionic one, taking possession of Omega Sentinel via email virus. thumb|left|124px|Random girl possessed by Malice ===Recorporealization=== Malice was recently able to "gather" her corporeal essence and get back to life again, and started to possess people in New York. Cyclops was able to detect her (possible with the help of Cerebra). While tracking her on a subway train he ran into a fight with Spider-Man. Malice was able to possess Cyclops for a few seconds before she was knocked unconscious by Spider-Man, who took the possessed Cyclops to his lab and separated Malice from Cyclops. He put her in a containment box that he later gave to Cyclops. Malice reappeared in a new body and rejoined the Marauders, who once again massacred the Morlock population. This led an angered Chamber, their new leader, to rejoin the X-Men. When the X-Men re-encountered the Morlocks, the Marauders fought briefly, but ultimately surrendered, professing their innocence. Not believing them, Chamber burned them to death with his psionic flame. Whether the death of a host body could kill Malice is unknown. ===Krakoa=== Malice later reappeared, possessing Rogue once more while Excalibur was resurrecting Captain Britain. She fled from Rogue's body and escaped onto Krakoa. She went on to possess Emma Frost and attacked Betsy, but was defeated by Kwannon. Both Betsy and Kwannon tried to get Malice to stop attacking people but Malice refused, as she wanted to force them to kill her. During the confrontation she was killed, however, she was then resurrected by the Five with a body of her own. She was granted mercy and given a fresh chance at life.

alice maguire.name: Alice Maguire
alice maguire.origin: Alice Maguire was a woman who lived in Forest Hills with her husband Ray and their son Andy, who they were both somewhat neglectful of. She and her husband had always been oblivious to their son's requests for a signed field trip permission slip, prompting him for forge it. When an accident happened during a field trip, Alice and Rayt came down to Horizon Labs with their lawyer Joan Conway to threaten legal action. However, when Max Modell offered Andy a job as Alpha, Alice became concerned that she and her husband weren't seeing enough money from the arrangement.

alice michaels.name: Alice Michaels
alice michaels.species: Human who was somehow transformed in a bug-monster queen. After being killed by Nico, she suffered another metamorphosis and gained her current appearance.
alice michaels.origin: Alice woke up one day, having acquired an insect form. She tried to hide it, but, unintentionally infected someone, which unleashed a plague of insect-like people. Meanwhile, A-Force was recovering from Thanos's attack, when they received information from the Inhuman precog Ulysses that Nico would kill someone named Alice. To avoid being arrested, Nico teleported herself to a safe house in Ouray, only to find the city completely crowded with insect-like people. thumb|left|230px Elsa Bloodstone then appeared and presented Nico to Janine, who happened to be Alice's mother. In that moment, the rest of A-Force appeared. After a brief discussion, they agreed Nico should not be arrested, so they split the team in two, with half going to an abandoned mine to search for Alice. There, they found out that Alice was responsible for everything that was happening and that the only way to revert everything back to normal was for Nico to kill Alice. After Elsa was infected, and everyone on the team (except Nico and Singularity) ended up contracting the disease, she trapped them in a time bubble and tried to revert Alice to her human appearance. Seeing this didn't solve the problem, Nico was forced to kill Alice, however, as the team regrouped, Alice was shown to have suffered another transformation and to be safe and sound. She then simply vanished.

alice parker.name: Alice Parker
alice parker.origin: The Angel arrives for a party celebrating the release of the newest book written by his friend John Parker. After being welcomed in by the butler, the Angel happens past a room where John Parker is having an argument with Jeff Van over Jeff's relationship with his daughter Alice. John refuses to allow Jeff to see Alice, but Jeff insists that they will be married someday if he likes it or not. Later on that evening as the party goers are proposing a toast to John, he suddenly keels over and dies, much to everyone's surprise. After the party is cleared out, the Angel asks John's friend Harvey who might be likely to kill John. Harvey tells him that Jeff Van is likely, as John and Jeff did not see eye to eye, as Jeff was a medical student and John figured Jeff was only interested in his daughter for the money to finish his education. Going to the coroner, the Angel learns that John was poisoned with strychnine. The Angel then goes to question Jeff but finds his home deserted and that someone had trashed his lab. Leaving the lab, the Angel spots Jeff trying to flee, and stops him. Although Jeff insists that he is innocent, the Angel takes him to the police anyway. Not convinced that Jeff is responsible, the Angel returns to the scene of the crime an examines the mess. Finding a pipe, he realizes that is what was used to transmit the poison. The Angel's investigation is interrupted by the butler who tells the Angel that Miss Parker wishes to speak with him. She also believes that Jeff is innocent. While the Angel goes to the jail to question Jeff again, and learns that Harvey offered him a job out of town, Harvey tries to make a pass at Alice. When the Angel realizes that Harvey is the killer he rushes back to the Parker home. There, Harvey refuses to accept Alice's rejection, deciding that if he can't have her, nobody can and starts a fire. While Alice suffers from smoke inhalation, Harvey attempts to get to safety out on the balcony. The Angel saves Alice, and then while to apprehend Harvey, his assailant stumbles off the ledge of the building and falls to his death. With the plot exposed, the charges against Jeff are dropped and he and Alice are reunited.

alice rifkin.name: Alice Rifkin
alice rifkin.first_appearance: Marvel Graphic Novel Vol 1 56: Power Pack & Cloak and Dagger: Shelter from the Storm
alice rifkin.origin: Alice was Marjorie Rifkin's mother and together with her husband Charles they hid letters of acceptance from prestigious universities to which Marjorie had applied for admission and had been accepted, this because they considered their daughter naive having always lived in a small country town and they wanted her to continue living there under their protection. Furthermore, the parents revealed that they had hidden other situations from her in the past, always for the same reason. This frustrated Marjorie to the point of running away from home, although Alice talking to her husband said that perhaps they had been too hard on Marjorie, but her husband replied that she must understand that she could not live without them.

alice rimes.name: Alice Rimes
alice rimes.origin: Alice Rimes was a girl at Citrusville High School and the only friend of Edmond Winshed, the boy who had died due to the physical strain put on him by the school's gym teacher. During Edmond's funeral Alice interrupts the eulogy to call them all on how horribly they treated Edmond, then Samuel, Edmund's uncle, rudely sent Alice away by throwing her into the nearby swamp, and at the end of the funeral in a rage he went to Alice again wanting to teach her a lesson. However, she is saved by the Man-Thing which is drawn by the violent emotions and burns Edmond's uncle and Alice manages to escape. The next day, Alice brought Edmund's diary to school with the intention of publishing it in the school yearbook where, among other things, the teacher Lewis Milner was publicly accused of murder. Milner and Edmond's relatives, fearing that the diary would be published, captured Alice and tied her up in the gym trying to force her to tell them the combination of the safe where she had hidden the diary, but attracted by the strong emotions expressed during the event, Man-Thing went to the school gymnasium, punishing Edmond's family members and killing Milner. Finally Alice was freed by the other students and going to the athletics track she saw Milner dead on the same spot where Edmond had died.

alice taylor.name: Alice Taylor
alice taylor.species: Human with Inhuman lineageCategory:Human/Inhuman HybridsCategory:Hybrids activated by a Terrigen Bomb
alice taylor.origin: Alice Taylor-Kedzierski was nineteen years old when she married Dennis Kedzierski and the two would go on to have a son named Tommy. After their son didn't return home from school, Alice mourned her loss while her husband held his grief alone. She always kept her own counsel. If her heart broke whenever she looked at her husband, she would not mention it, but down inside, she'd never admit it, and all she wanted in the world was for her husband to be himself again. When Black Bolt detonated the Terrigen Bomb while battling Thanos, Alice was affected by the Terrigen Mists due to her Inhuman lineage. After emerging from her cocoon, she accidentally enlarged her husband, causing Alice, two of her neighbors, and her house to shrink to the Microverse. Alice, with the help of Wasp and Wonder Man, was able to enlarge her house and her neighbors and shrink her husband back to their original proportions.

alicia masters.name: Alicia Masters
alicia masters.origin: ===Early Life=== Born to Jacob and Marcia Reiss, Alicia grew to love painting as a kid. When her father's resentful research partner Phillip Masters sabotaged their factory, Jacob died in the explosion of the radioactive clay they were studying, and Alicia was struck blind. Claiming the catastrophic event was an accident, Phillip took Alicia under his wing, teaching her how to sculpt with clay. Phillip ended up marrying Alicia's mother, and Alicia took his last name. Marcia eventually died of radiation poisoning contracted from the factory's explosion, and Alicia moved with her adopted father to Manhattan where she studied at a special school for the blind. thumb|right|Alicia as a child Becoming mentally unstable from the experimentation with the radioactive clay, which he discovered allowed him to take control of people, Phillip fashioned himself the alter-ego of the Puppet Master and set his sights on world domination. To this end, he took control of the Thing of the Fantastic Four, hoping to use him as a pawn. When the Invisible Girl followed her entranced teammate to a rendez-vous with the Puppet Master, Alicia's keen hearing detected the intruder. The Puppet Master knocked out Sue, had Alicia disguse herself as her, and sent her unwitting step-daughter with the Thing back to the Fantastic Four. When Mr. Fantastic freed Ben from the Puppet Master's control with a chemical formula that temporarily reverted Ben back to human form, Alicia was completely taken by Ben's personality if not his rugged appearance, which was something that Grimm was ashamed of at the time. With Alicia's help, the Fantastic Four rescued Sue, though Puppet Master managed to escape. Returning home, Phillip was confronted by Alicia and fell through the window to his apparent death during a scuffle. left|thumb|Alicia as a young adult ===Relationship with Ben Grimm=== Following the apparent demise of her step-father, Alicia became close friends with the Fantastic Four and began spending a lot of time with Ben Grimm. She attempted to show the Thing his inner beauty, but Ben's depression over his transformation into a monster made this a difficult struggle for him. Eventually the pair began dating and Alicia put her sculpting skill into use creating replicas of the Fantastic Four's foes and of the Four themselves. The two went on dates together, and Alicia once even managed to convince the Thing to allow her to come along on a rescue mission with the rest of the Fantastic Four when the Invisible Girl was kidnapped by the Sub-Mariner, who was secretly the control of the Puppet Master. fields.additional_attributes: Blindness: Alicia Masters was blinded when at age 15. However, she has adapted and learnt to deal with this very well, for instance gaining her sculpting skills and apparently memorizing most of Manhattan, being able to get around the city as easily as an out-of-town visitor can.
equipment: Billy Club / Cane: A special white cane which can be split into a double baton for self-defense. It was a birthday gift from Matt Murdock.
fields.notes: Her father attempted to repair her sight by transplanting the eyes of women he murdered into Alicia . None of these surgeries were successful, leaving Alicia still blind, but with the eyes of another woman .
fields.trivia: When a fan asked Stan Lee for Alicia's surname, Lee admitted he never thought about that, and organized a contest so that the fans could choose Alicia's surname. Kathy Goles from Chicago won the contest and "Masters" was chosen because she was the step-daughter of the Puppet Master.

alicia wells.name: Alicia Wells
alicia wells.first_appearance: Captain America and the Secret Avengers Vol 1 1
alicia wells.origin: She was the founder of L.A.S.S.E.S., a pseudo-school where teenagers were taught to become hired killers. During a gala with various sinister world government and corrupt figures in finance and industry to introduce the new L.A.S.S.E.S. graduate group, Lady Wells had all the wealthy patrons poisoned so that she could blackmail them for the antidote. Lady Wells was killed by Sharon Carter who shot her before a student of hers for whom the Black Widow, along with Sharon, had snuck into the gala in order to remove her from that milieu of murderous mercenaries.

aliman lor.name: Aliman Lor
aliman lor.origin: General Aliman Lor was the first democratically elected president of the African nation of Akima, after a war for independence during which he sided with rebel forces, overthrowing its unelected governor Adrian Warsame. However, he was suspected for war crimes executed during that time. He visited New York City when he was set to adress the United Nations, for Akima to be recognized as a country. His vehicle was attacked by an unnamed hitman, but Lor's death was prevented by Moon Knight. The hitman activated an EMP which shut down a major part of New York, in order to slow Lor down, and chased him while Moon Knight pursued the hitman. During an opportunity to talk with the hitman, Moon Knight learned that he was a part of a recon team sent to Akima by the UN, and witnessed Lor's crimes. The hitman promised the families of the victims that Lor was going to pay for his crimes. One of the hitman's benefactors was Elisa Warsame, the daughter of Adrian Warsame. Moon Knight still stopped the hitman, as Lor's death wouldn't have served justice. When Aliman Lor was finally going to adress the United Nations, Warsame, now bestowed with the powers of Khonshu, manipulated UN Security officer Gloria Roza into attempting to murder him. However, her plan was thwarted by Marc Spector, the civilian identity of Moon Knight, at the cost of being blamed for the attack. Warsame managed to later kidnap and keep Lor prisoner for days with the help of mercenaries, demanding him the fortune that formerly belonged to her father. Moon Knight arrived just in time to prevent her from choking Lor to death.

alioth.name: Alioth
alioth.origin: thumb|left|Domain of Alioth on the map of the Realm of Known Time Alioth is the first being who broke free from the constraints of time. His empire is larger than that of Kang himself, stretching billions of years to before the rise of man on Earth. His domain is approximately 2x to 3x as large as Kang's temporal empire. It is because of Alioth that Kang never attempted to expand his empire vertically into more distant time eras and therefore extends only as far back as 2000 BC. Kang created a barrier preventing Alioth from entering his domain. After Kang was left on the brink of death, Ravonna the Terminatrix assumed his identity and took over his Empire. While investigating eras earlier in time, she accidentally released Alioth who then threatened Kang's former domain and all other temporal dominions further up the timestream. Ravonna and Revelation were able to revive Kang who provided the Avengers with the Chrono Key to use against Alioth, which was, in reality, Tempus, who upon being released inside Alioth, grew to match it in power, locking the two in eternal combat. Later Kang would, as part of his machinations to keep his rival temporal empires occupied, weaken Tempus so that Alioth could break through, invading the dominion of the Congress of Realities.
