amadeus cho.species: One of the smartest Humans on Earth; also later mutated by gamma rays
amadeus cho.origin: ===Early Life=== Amadeus Cho was a Korean-American born and raised in Tucson, Arizona. Above average was insufficient to define this extraordinary teen. His parents Helen and Phil emigrated from South Korea before he was born. They had quite a passion for historical names, something they showed the moment they had to name their two children. Their son was named after the composer , and a daughter, Madame Curie Cho, called Maddy for short. The Cho's lived a normal and happy life, but Amadeus showed from his very childhood that he was different: he was incredibly smart for such a young boy, and learned a lot of things by himself, becoming highly cultured and increasing his already remarkable intelligence. Helen supported her genius son and tried to go along with his talent. The more Amadeus grew up, the more his parents realized he was a genius. When the boy was fifteen years old, the Excello, a soap corporation, announced an online game to reward young geniuses, a quiz show named Brain Fight. Amadeus participated, and he easily won the $5,000 reward, placing first. Helen and Philip, of course, were happy for their son's results, but they didn't know this was just the beginning of the end for their family. The person who had organized Brain Fight, in fact, was another genius and former child prodigy, Pythagoras Dupree, whose real aim was to search the world for other people whose intellect might rival his own...and to eliminate them as unwanted rivals. By winning his game, Amadeus Cho had been awarded the title of Mastermind Excello and the position of "7th Smartest Man in the World" (Pythagoras, by his own claim, was the 6th), and that was more than enough a reason to be killed. Dupree had his men attack Amadeus' house, and in the following explosion, Helen, and her husband got killed. Amadeus ran away with his only companion being a coyote pup Kirby. thumb|left ===The Hulk=== Agents tracked him down but not before Amadeus ran into to another misunderstood genius with awesome power: the Hulk. The Hulk protected Mastermind, who then considered him his friend. Some time later, a terrible accident involving super-heroes in Stamford, Connecticut killed 612 including the school children. The "Stamford Incident" gave rise to the Superhuman Registration Act. S.H.I.E.L.D. went to apprehend the unregistered Mastermind Excello. After outsmarting some S.H.I.E.L.D. agents, Amadeus discovered a hide-out in New Mexico that once belonged to his friend the Hulk. There Amadeus hacked into the Baxter Building security network and discovered that a group of heroes called the Illuminati, including Mr. Fantastic of the Fantastic Four and the Avenger Iron Man, had sent the Hulk into exile in outer space. Using a special phone line, he informed Reed Richards about his discovery. A satellite revealed that the Hulk wasn't where the Illuminati thought they had sent their former friend. Amadeus left Reed thinking about his betrayal of his former ally and friend while Amadeus set off to find the Hulk. The Hulk soon returned to earth with his Warbound looking for revenge. Cho restored She-Hulk's powers after finding her de-powered by Tony Stark's S.P.I.N. tech. Cho tried to recruit her to his cause. She-Hulk declined, choosing instead to get revenge on Stark using the legal system, but put him in contact with Hercules and Angel who owed the Hulk due to an altercation from when they were part of the Champions. Cho used Angel's money to buy a submarine. The trio went off to recruit Namor. Wanting no part of the Illuminati's plot to begin with, Namor dismissed Cho's idea. Namora decided to join the three in her cousin's place. thumb|right Cho's group offered their help to Hulk, but he dismissed them but was forced to accept help due to General Ross's attack. S.H.I.E.L.D. eventually recruited Cho's team to protect the non-evacuated civilians. Cho eventually met Rick Jones but didn't see eye-to-eye with him. Cho's group met up with Scorpion to find and free the heroes captured by the Warbound. Seeing the way the heroes were being treated caused Cho to confront the Hulk alone. Cho attempted to show Hulk that he wished to create a safe haven for him but he was attacked, causing Hercules and his crew to come to Cho's aid. The Hulk left after Cho argued that his anger was what killed his loved ones and that Banner was what kept them loving him. When Zom possessed Stark's Hulkbuster armor, Cho and his crew captured the demon with Wong's help. When Hulk was defeated, Cho and Hercules became prisoners of S.H.I.E.L.D. ===Hercules=== During his imprisonment, S.H.I.E.L.D. decided that Cho's intelligence was going to be beneficial in moving the evacuated New Yorkers back to their homes. He declined, believing that if he did they would eventually make him a tool their militaristic plans. Hercules also didn't like S.H.I.E.L.D.'s plans for him rescued Cho and escaped. By winning his game, Amadeus Cho had been awarded the title of Mastermind Excello and the position of "7th Smartest Man in the World" (Pythagoras, by his own claim, was the 6th), and that was more than enough a reason to be killed. Dupree had his men attack Amadeus' house, and in the following explosion, Helen, and her husband got killed. Amadeus ran away with his only companion being a coyote pup Kirby. thumb|left ===The Hulk=== Agents tracked him down but not before Amadeus ran into to another misunderstood genius with awesome power: the Hulk. The Hulk protected Mastermind, who then considered him his friend. Some time later, a terrible accident involving super-heroes in Stamford, Connecticut killed 612 including the school children. The "Stamford Incident" gave rise to the Superhuman Registration Act. S.H.I.E.L.D. went to apprehend the unregistered Mastermind Excello. After outsmarting some S.H.I.E.L.D. agents, Amadeus discovered a hide-out in New Mexico that once belonged to his friend the Hulk. There Amadeus hacked into the Baxter Building security network and discovered that a group of heroes called the Illuminati, including Mr. Fantastic of the Fantastic Four and the Avenger Iron Man, had sent the Hulk into exile in outer space. Using a special phone line, he informed Reed Richards about his discovery. A satellite revealed that the Hulk wasn't where the Illuminati thought they had sent their former friend. Amadeus left Reed thinking about his betrayal of his former ally and friend while Amadeus set off to find the Hulk. The Hulk soon returned to earth with his Warbound looking for revenge. Cho restored She-Hulk's powers after finding her de-powered by Tony Stark's S.P.I.N. tech. Cho tried to recruit her to his cause. She-Hulk declined, choosing instead to get revenge on Stark using the legal system, but put him in contact with Hercules and Angel who owed the Hulk due to an altercation from when they were part of the Champions. Cho used Angel's money to buy a submarine. The trio went off to recruit Namor. Wanting no part of the Illuminati's plot to begin with, Namor dismissed Cho's idea. Namora decided to join the three in her cousin's place. thumb|right Cho's group offered their help to Hulk, but he dismissed them but was forced to accept help due to General Ross's attack. S.H.I.E.L.D. eventually recruited Cho's team to protect the non-evacuated civilians. Cho eventually met Rick Jones but didn't see eye-to-eye with him. Cho's group met up with Scorpion to find and free the heroes captured by the Warbound. Seeing the way the heroes were being treated caused Cho to confront the Hulk alone. Cho attempted to show Hulk that he wished to create a safe haven for him but he was attacked, causing Hercules and his crew to come to Cho's aid. The Hulk left after Cho argued that his anger was what killed his loved ones and that Banner was what kept them loving him. When Zom possessed Stark's Hulkbuster armor, Cho and his crew captured the demon with Wong's help. He declined, believing that if he did they would eventually make him a tool their militaristic plans. Hercules also didn't like S.H.I.E.L.D.'s plans for him rescued Cho and escaped. amahl farouk.name: Amahl Farouk
amahl farouk.origin: === Background === Amahl Farouk was born in Egypt Eyalet in the 16th century the son of a merchant trader, his mutant powers of telepathy emerged at an early age in contrast to other mutants, he decided to use these powers to protect the market from thieves until tragedy struck in the form of a plague. Amahl's father contracted the plague and Amahl stayed by his side while he died. It is suggested that he felt his father's death with his powers as though it were his own. Amahl was left alone, the sole survivor until the Shadow King appeared to him and promised him that he would give him the chance of never being alone again. Having lost everything and feeling dead inside, Amahl accepted the deal and bonded with the Shadow King. === The Shadow King === A few centuries later, shortly before World War II, Farouk worked with Baron von Strucker on a plot to destabilize Britain's political structure, with the intention being Britain allying with Germany in the coming war, or at the very least, staying neutral. He captured a time-displaced Rachel Summers, intending to sacrifice in a ritual, however Kitty Pryde came to her rescue and he attacked her, being surprised at her knowing his true identity. A few decades later, became the leader of the underground syndicate located in the "Thieves' Quarter" of Cairo, Egypt and took the alias of the Shadow King. While Charles Xavier was touring Cairo he had his pockets picked by Ororo, a girl "trained" by Farouk. After catching her, Xavier was suddenly stuck by a psi-bolt sent from the possessed Farouk and was knocked unconscious. He awoke and entered a nearby saloon owned by Amahl. Farouk greeted Xavier and then offered him a partnership. Xavier refused and challenged Farouk to a duel. After a brief battle, Xavier mentally defeated Farouk; after that, Xavier took his leave from Cairo. Despite his apparent death at Xavier's "hands", Farouk reappeared many years later as the Shadow King once more. Farouk later became a citizen of the mutant-only island of Krakoa. Farouk began mentoring a group of young mutants, who did not like their appearance and encourage their synergizing of their powers, such as experimenting with the corpses in the Boneyard. Although he had the New Mutants trust, Scout was suspicious of him and after warning her friends to stay away from him several times she was eventually forced to confront him. While they were alone he told her he still feels the Shadow Kings influence but it's weaker on the island and that he wanted to make sure these children could protect themselves. The next day Gabby was found dead after Magneto and his fellow omega level mutants terraformed Mars, having been murdered by Wolfsbane under the possession of the Shadow King. After Scout was revived they confronted him and pushed Farouk to bring them all to the Astral Plane where they battled the Shadow King. The New Mutants convinced Farouk to break his connection to the evil being and redeem himself. With the influence of the Shadow King gone from him, Farouk regretted what he had done under his control and left Krakoa to improve himself.

fields.personality: As a child, Amahl Farouk was a gentle and kind person, after discovering his powers of telepathy, he decided he would put his powers to good use and defend his market from thieves. However, after losing the market and his father to the plague while also experiencing the latter's death, Amahl became depressive and feared to be left alone, so much that he let the Shadow King possess him to never be alone again. While possessed by the Shadow King, Farouk became greedy, power-hungry and sadistic, wanting to gain power in order to rise to the top. He was also noted to be hedonistic.

amahle van scotter.name: Amahle van Scotter
amahle van scotter.origin: Amahle was a South African of Zulu descent. While sailing on a boat her school had charted for an art class, she met a crew member of Afrikaner descent named Mattias van Scotter. After Amahle took initiative and approached him, they started dating. They married years laters, and had a daughter named Jubulile. When Jubulile was close to turning 16 years old, Mattias died of a terminal illness.

amalgam.name: Amalgam
amalgam.origin: During the Mutant Massacre, the mysterious figure known as Amalgam approached the badly injured Warren Worthington III, offering him the choice to either die or be absorbed into her, allowing his powers and knowledge to live on and fight for mutant-kind. She claimed she had offered the same choice to many of the Morlocks left on the brink of death by the Massacre. To convince him, she took on the form and identities of the Beast and Cyclops, who claimed to have been absorbed by her at some point in the future after they had been killed by Sentinels. Worthington accepted her offer, but she realized it was not his time to die, and ended the attempt at absorbing him. Years later, Worthington, now Archangel, saw Amalgam again, after being badly injured fighting mutant terrorists. She laughed and called him a 'tease', before apparently absorbing the terrorist leader. Worthington was left unsure if either or both of her appearances had been real or just pain-induced hallucinations.

amalia chavez.name: Amalia Chavez
amalia chavez.origin: ===Utopian Parallel=== Amalia Chavez was a practiced microbiologist and a renowned doctor from the Bronx alongside her wife Elena, a pathologist. While their two daughters, America and Catalina, were infants, America was diagnosed with Edges Syndrome- a fatal genetic disease linked to the XX chromosomes in girls. left|thumb|125px|Amalia debating Gales' offer Four months after the diagnosis, the Doctors Chavez were invited by billionaire Mr. Gales to his private island far from the coast of Long Island, dubbed "The Utopian Parallel", where he had established an advanced medical facility to research Edges Syndrome. When Gales showed Amalia and Elena the Starling Chamber, Gales revealed a doorway to a pocket reality where the natural energies could allow for a treatment and give their daughters the chance to grow up as the pocket sapce's inherent energies could allow them to recover from their diagnoses. However, feeling the chamber's use would be unethical due to a plethora of unaccounted for variables, Amalia and Elena originally believed in refusing the offer until Gales' played on their daughters futures and convinced them to stay. right|thumb|125px|Amalia's last act For two years, Amalia worked with Elena on Gales' research. But as he became more fixated on America learning how to generate portals, Amalia realized Gales was intent on privatizing the process and the girls. With America in remission and Catalina still healthy, Amalia initially worried for her daughters until she and Elena formed a plan to escape with the other girls. However, while Amalia got the other girls to rendezvous to meet with Elena, she was spotted on the way by the island security and led them to the chamber. There, she called her wife to tell her and their daughters she loved them, while unpinning a grenade to throw into the chamber. Amalia destroyed the chamber and the area of the island with it, as the explosion killed herself and her pursuers in the attempt to allow Elena to exfiltrate the children. ===Legacy=== From America's traumatic fantasizing of events, Amalia and Elena were reimagined by America as superheroes and the Utopian Parallel as a paradisal dimension beyond the Multiverse in the presence of the Demiurge. 125px|thumb|left|Amalia's fantasized death in America's mind In this fantasy, Amalia and Elena heroically sacrificed themselves to prevent Utopia from being dragged into the common Multiverse by black holes and their particles were dispersed across the Multiverse itself. America chose to become a superhero to honor both mothers. The "Amerimoms" were briefly "resurrected" to act as pawns of Mother. Due to a spell from Loki, the "Amerimoms", Captain Glory, and Star Splendor were banished. right|thumb|150px|Elena & Amalia speak to their daughters Approximately thirteen years after death, Amalia and Elena's research was used by Catalina after Gales forcefully stimulated her Edges Syndrome to replicate America's powers. After Catalina escaped Gales' custody, she replicated their research to a modest extent and took in 30 young girls for testing. As Catalina gave America sodium thiopental to remember the truth, the former coerced America into opening a Star Portal to bring their mothers back to life. Both daughters could hear the voices of their mothers, but the voices stopped after the portal opened which tragically sent Catalina anywhere in the Multiverse. When America returned to New York, she distributed Amalia and Elena's research to the scientific community, which earned them recognition for their studies in the newspapers.

amalric the aquilonian.name: Amalric the Aquilonian
amalric the aquilonian.origin: Amalric the Aquilonian was, along with Conan, part of a mercenary army that invaded Stygia and was ultimately decimated as a result of treachery. Amalric become separated from Conan, but the latter spied him, days later, with a beautiful girl named Lissa being chased across the night desert by seven fiery-eyed, skull-faced horsemen. However, the monsters vanished as soon as conan rushed to his friend's aid. Amalric took Lissa back to her birthplace, Gazal, only to then save her from Ollam-Onga, the demon of the red tower. He was later pursued once more by the skull-riders, however, he safely reached Tombalku, where he slew a local wizard named Askia. Afterward, Almaric and Conan encountered an approaching caravan outside the city gates, they followed the traders to bypass Tombalku's civil war, and joined their group.

amalya.name: Amalya
amalya.origin: Originally a princess from an unnamed planet, Amalya was kidnapped and held captive by a gang of criminals until she was rescued by Rocket Raccoon. She instantly fell in love with him, and the two had a brief relationship before Rocket left her and pilfered a small fortune from her family. Cast out for dishonoring the reputation of her house, and heartbroken by rejection, the now "General" Amalya assembled a team of Rocket's ex-girlfriends from across the galaxy to make him pay at any cost.

aman sinaya.name: Aman Sinaya
aman sinaya.species: One of the three primary Diwata
aman sinaya.origin: Aman Sinaya was one of the three primary Diwata sired by Gaea, along with Bathala and Amihan, and was the goddess of the sea. Together, the three gods fashioned the first mortals from a bamboo shoot, instilling them with a soul (or "kaluluwa"). The belief in the Diwatas started from approximately 4000 BC. In 1000 AD, the Third Host of the Celestials occurred, during which the aliens informed they would return 1,000 years later to judge Earth's right to continue existing. While the pantheons prepared for war, Gaea planned a peaceful solution to the problem with many goddesses, among them Aman Sinaya for the Diwatas. For the next thousand years, they searched for humans representing mankind's highest ideals, to be offered to the Celestials as an offering. The goddesses placed the candidates in suspended animation, with their superhuman potential, the legacy of the First Host, awakened. The worship of the Diwatas lasted until the 16 century AD. left|thumb|Aman Sinaya, Zuras, & Aswang attend the Council of Godheads In modern times, Aman Sinaya (alongside Zuras of the Eternals and Aswang of the Diwatas) gathered amongst other gods in an undisclosed extradimensional realm to witness the Council of Godheads judge the worthiness of Phobos to become the next Olympian god of fear.

amanda armstrong.name: Amanda Armstrong
amanda armstrong.origin: Amanda Armstrong's father was a secret federal agent killed in the line of duty by A.I.M., though the public and Amanda were led to believe he had been murdered by a drug cartel. As a young adult, Amanda became a small-time musician under the stage name of Amanda Strong. One night after a performance, she was recruited into S.H.I.E.L.D. by Valentina Allegra de Fontaine, hoping to use her career as a cover for missions around the world. With the help of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s contacts, Amanda became a moderately successful vocalist for her own band. One night before travelling to Germany to deliver a package, she met the package's courier, a fellow S.H.I.E.L.D. agent named Jude. When she arrived to the Indra Club in Hamburg, Amanda's cover was blown, and she was attacked by an assassin. Jude saved her life, later admitting that he had followed her to Germany hoping to see her performance and ask her on a date afterwards. The two agents were soon intercepted by undercover Hydra soldiers, but managed to escape from the hotel where Jude had taken Amanda regardless of the enemy presence. thumb|left|Young Amanda The incident at the Indra Club was covered up as an attack from an overzealous fan, allowing Amanda to remain operating undercover. She continued her career, and started dating Jude. After a two-year relationship, Amanda became pregnant and quit S.H.I.E.L.D.. A week before the baby was due, Jude tried to convince Amanda to disappear. He eventually revealed to have been working as a Hydra double-agent, showing his true nature as a selfish man who had no problem working for both sides and selling out fellow agents as long as it made profit. As Jude was trying to convince Amanda to accept Hydra's protection, she stabbed him in the neck with a pair of scissors. Shocked by this development, Amanda decided she was going to give up the baby for adoption to a happy and safe family, requesting wherever he was sent to, the baby retained his birth name: Anthony. S.H.I.E.L.D. partially granted Amanda her wish, and instead left the baby in an orphanage in Sofia, Bulgaria, the place where it was born. After learning of Amanda's pregnancy, S.H.I.E.L.D. founder Howard Stark kept an eye on the baby and adopted him, taking the birth records in the process. thumb|right|Reunited with her son Decades later, Amanda had become a London-based music producer. When Tony Stark investigated his true parentage, he found that Amanda could've been his true mother, and visited her at her record label. Tony demonstrated his desire to get to know his mother, and the two hugged as Amanda called him, "My boy." Before Amanda could bond with her son, Tony fell into a coma as a consequence of the second superhuman civil war. Tony's company, Stark Industries, fell to the hands of Amanda as established by his will. Amanda accepted the position to prevent the board of directors from taking control of the company, while Tony's A.I. assistant Friday ran the company behind the curtains. When Tony recovered from his injuries, he went into hiding for a brief time. After he meet up with Amanda to ensure her he was safe, she was approached by Jude. He revealed her he had been resurrected by Hydra, and continued operating from behind the scenes for decades, only deciding to step into the light after learning what had become of their son. Jude coerced her into luring Tony to a trap. However, Tony's assistant Mary Jane Watson appeared and shot Jude in the shoulder, which prompted him to decloak a battalion of Hydra soldiers. A massive fight sparked after Ironheart and many other heroes arrived to confront Hydra. In the middle of the brawl, Jude got hold of MJ's gun and tried to shoot Amanda in the back. Before he could to so, he was knocked out by Iron Man. Amanda joined the upper management of her son's subsequent enterprise, the think tank called Stark Unlimited. She hit it off with roboticist Andy Bhang, a music aficionado and a fan of hers, and eventually got into a relationship with him. On the other hand, Amanda found it hard to connect with her son, and struggled to find common ground with him since Tony was constantly occupied; something Amanda worried Tony was doing on purpose to avoid her. thumb|250px|left|Amanda being confronted by Motherboard inside the eScape When Tony launched his next major project, a virtual landscape called the eScape, Amanda followed him into the digital world, but she was abducted by the eScape's operating system, Motherboard, who had been unwittingly damaged and left corrupted by a hacker attack from the villainous Controller. Motherboard was a program made from the engrams of Tony's late adoptive mother Maria Stark, and she contended that she was Tony's true mother. To this end, Motherboard used her ability to warp eScape to her whim to enthrall Tony. amanda brayden.name: Amanda Brayden
amanda brayden.first_appearance: All Select Comics 70th Anniversary Special Vol 1 1
amanda brayden.origin: Amanda was injured in an accident where she was hit by a drunk driver, which led her to undergo surgery which as a result could not have children. Wanting to take revenge on the one who had invested her, she pretended to be paralyzed and exploiting the guilt of the man who in the meantime was recovering from alcoholism, she managed to conquer him and after he separated from his first wife, he married Amanda by signing a prenuptial agreement where in the event of her husband's death she would inherit her fortunes only after five years of marriage. At the end of the five years, and in the day she was run over, she killed her husband thinking she would get away with it as she was paralyzed and the murder had been committed on the first floor of their apartment, she would be exonerated, but intuition and the investigative skills of Louise Mason, aka Blonde Phantom, uncovered the deception and Amanda was captured and arrested on murder charges.

amanda mueller.name: Amanda Müeller
amanda mueller.origin: ===Origins=== thumb|left|Amanda Müeller Amanda Müeller was born in the 19th-century to a presumably wealthy background. She possessed an early example of mutant genes, making her a ripe commodity for the immortal geneticist Dr. Nathaniel Essex. Calling himself Milbury, Essex entered into an arrangement with Müeller where she married a man and became pregnant, then feigned miscarriages so that Essex could take these mutant infants and study their genetic material. It seems Müeller was well compensated for her efforts. In 1891, after surviving a series of miscarriages, Amanda Müeller came under suspicion and was accused of being the Black Womb killer. Milbury testified on her behalf, and she was ultimately found not guilty at trial, although her genuine innocence was still in question. Müeller was married to Daniel Summers, who left Amanda with their only son because he couldn't handle the accusations. ===Black Womb Project=== Because of her mutation, Amanda was extremely long lived. Decades ago, she was part of government research project that was gaining research on mutants. Other members included Kurt Marko (father of the Juggernaut and stepfather of Charles Xavier) and Irene Adler (lover of Mystique). Amanda must have had a slowed aging factor as she gave birth to a woman called Fontanelle who was in her early fifties in the early twentieth century. thumb|left Amanda headed the Black Womb Project in her later years. In one video she smothered a mutant child for her research. Amanda retained her mutant powers after M-Day. After Mr. Sinister was nearly killed in Messiah Complex, he tried to slip into the mind of Professor X or Sebastian Shaw using his Cronus device. Amanda was aware of Sinister's plan, and vowed to kill Professor X and Shaw so she could steal Sinister's power for herself. While Professor X beat Sinister mentally and Gambit charged up Shaw to destroy the Cronus device, Amanda saw her chance to escape in the ensuing chaos. ===Fall of X=== Amidst the fall of Krakoa, Müeller became the secret head of Parvenu Industries, aiming to complete her life's work of creating the Neocracy. A clone of Müeller once revealed this goal to Sinister. During the confrontation between her and Cable, her nutrient tanks got dealt a damaging blow that resulted in her dying slowly. When agents from Parvenu Industries were harvesting her corpse, it was said that her body had become like liquid.

amanda saint.name: Amanda Saint
amanda saint.origin: Amanda Saint's mother left her when her father discovered she had been involved with the satanic cult, Demon-Fire. Her father soon left, searching for his wife. Amanda stayed at home with her older sister Catherine, and dated a guy named Justin. Unbeknownst to Amanda, both her sister and her boyfriend were also members of Demon-Fire, who sought to use her as a virgin sacrifice. Amanda was rescued from their first attempt at capture by the living vampire Morbius, who originally had planned on using her as a victim himself. Upon returning home, she was quickly captured and was to be sacrificed to the spider-demon Arachne. Morbius saved her again, and most of the members of the San Francisco sect, including her sister, were killed and their temple destroyed. In search of her mother, Amanda and Morbius traveled to Malevolence, Maine, where they stayed in the boarding house of a Mrs. Agnes, who was actually Sister Saint in disguise. Blood-Tide, leader of the Malevolence sect, directed Sister Saint to kill the two, but Morbius saved her again, eventually slaying Blood-Tide. Sister Saint fell on her own axe and split her head open. Morbius left out the details, but told her that he learned that her mother was dead. In search of her father, Amanda and Morbius arrived at the amusement park in Gallow's Bend, Nevada. There they found her father, recently hanged by other members of Demon-Fire. They were attacked by Reaper, Death-Flame, Rigor, Phineas T. Coroner, and eventually the leader of the whole cult, Apocalypse. In the course of the battle, Amanda allowed Morbius to drink some of her blood to regain his strength to battle the cult. Ultimately, Howie Rivers , owner of the amusement park, decided to sacrifice his park to stop the demons. He and Sagebrush Robbins, either an employee or a local defending the area from demons, wired the park with dynamite and blew it up, killing Apocalypse and every other cult member present. What became of Amanda after this is unknown.

amanda sefton.origin: Jimaine Szardos, a.k.a. Amanda Sefton, is the daughter of the sorceress Margali Szardos. Like her mother, she is a sorceress. As Amanda, Jimaine is a long-time love interest of the X-Man Nightcrawler (Kurt Wagner), who was raised from infancy as her adopted brother. In her early life, Jimaine lived nomadically as part of a Roma caravan and traveling circus in Eastern Europe along with her mother and brother Stephan Szardos. During this time period, Margali took custody of the infant mutant Kurt Wagner whose physical characteristics led many superstitious people to believe he was a demon. Unbeknownst to either Jimaine or Margali, Stephan suffered from bouts of homicidal madness and made his foster brother Kurt swear to kill him if he ever became truly violent. Though hesitant, Kurt made the pact and when Stephan eventually did go on a rampage, he was forced to honor it. Although he wanted to explain his actions to his foster family, Margali and Jimaine had vanished. (Kurt then accepted Prof. Xavier's offer to join the new team of X-Men as Nightcrawler.) Distraught at the turn of events, Margali began plotting to seek revenge against Kurt for his supposed betrayal. But Jimaine, who was in love with Kurt, couldn't believe he'd acted maliciously. Hoping to find out more information, she adopted the alias Amanda Sefton, a flight attendant. She and fellow stewardess Betsy Wilford met Kurt and his fellow X-Man Piotr Rasputin (a.k.a. Colossus) on Christmas Eve, just prior to the X-Men's conflict with Steven Lang's Sentinels. At that time, she appeared to everyone, including Kurt, to be an ordinary person with no previous connection to him. Months later, Kurt and Piotr went on another double date with “Amanda” and Betsy in which they were all kidnapped by the assassin Arcade. While Kurt, Piotr and the other X-Men were made to face various deathtraps in Murderworld, the women were held prisoner but eventually released. Amanda continued to present as an ordinary person and demonstrated no magical abilities then. Eventually, Margali attempted to exact revenge for Stephan's death by constructing a facsimile of Hell as described in Dante Alighieri's epic poem Inferno as a prison for him. The X-Men, aided by Dr. Strange, sought to rescue Kurt. During the final confrontation with Margali, Jimaine intervened on Kurt's behalf. Afterwards, she revealed to Kurt that she was Amanda. With the truth revealed, Jimaine continued to use the name Amanda and work as a flight attendant while still dating Kurt. Although she was not often involved in X-Men adventures, she used her magic to aid them at some key junctures. Most notably, when the Hellfire Club invaded Xavier's school and took most of the team (and several associates, such as herself) hostage. Amanda quietly cast a spell to make it appear that Wolverine had died. This allowed Wolverine to move freely around the mansion and help turn the tide against their attackers. After an incident with the Beyonder, Nightcrawler suffered a crisis of faith. He broke up with Amanda and distanced himself from her, causing her considerable anguish. Kurt was later mortally wounded during a battle with the Marauders and was left comatose for months. The rest of the X-Men went into hiding before the conflict could be resolved. Amanda then attempted to become Doctor Strange's disciple, leading to a brief conflict between her mother Margali and the Sorcerer Supreme. After learning that Kurt had resurfaced as a member of Excalibur in the United Kingdom, Amanda traveled to Muir Island to try and find him. She was there when the island came under attack by the Reavers and joined the temporary, ad hoc team known as the Muir Island X-Men. Amanda remained at Muir until the residents were possessed by the Shadow King. After the Muir Island Saga, she gave up superheroics. Kurt called her out of retirement to help retrieve Captain Britain from the time stream. She almost managed the feat but had to exchange Rachel Summers for Brian. Kurt and Amanda then traveled to Germany where their mother had been captured by D'Spayre. They saved Margali and afterwards Amanda joined Excalibur. Later, Amanda convinced Shadowcat to give Magik's Soulsword to her mother for safekeeping. But Margali instead used it to kill every magician ahead of her on the Winding Way and then joined the London branch of the Inner Circle of the Hellfire Club as the Red Queen. After defeating Margali, Amanda parted ways from Excalibur without telling anyone. The truth was that Margali had secretly taken over her body while the true Amanda was held captive by Belasco. Amanda eventually freed herself and defeated her mother once again. She realized that someone needed to rule Limbo and took on the mantle herself. She changed her codename to Magik as a tribute to Illyana. Like Belasco had, she controlled the teleportinging "stepping discs" of Limbo through magic. The Archenemy arose out of an attempt to catalog various magics. Amanda was tricke

In her early life, Jimaine lived nomadically as part of a Roma caravan and traveling circus in Eastern Europe along with her mother and brother Stephan Szardos. During this time period, Margali took custody of the infant mutant Kurt Wagner whose physical characteristics led many superstitious people to believe he was a demon. Unbeknownst to either Jimaine or Margali, Stephan suffered from bouts of homicidal madness and made his foster brother Kurt swear to kill him if he ever became truly violent. Though hesitant, Kurt made the pact and when Stephan eventually did go on a rampage, he was forced to honor it. Although he wanted to explain his actions to his foster family, Margali and Jimaine had vanished. (Kurt then accepted Prof. Xavier's offer to join the new team of X-Men as Nightcrawler.) Distraught at the turn of events, Margali began plotting to seek revenge against Kurt for his supposed betrayal. But Jimaine, who was in love with Kurt, couldn't believe he'd acted maliciously. Hoping to find out more information, she adopted the alias Amanda Sefton, a flight attendant. She and fellow stewardess Betsy Wilford met Kurt and his fellow X-Man Piotr Rasputin (a.k.a. Colossus) on Christmas Eve, just prior to the X-Men's conflict with Steven Lang's Sentinels. At that time, she appeared to everyone, including Kurt, to be an ordinary person with no previous connection to him. Months later, Kurt and Piotr went on another double date with “Amanda” and Betsy in which they were all kidnapped by the assassin Arcade. While Kurt, Piotr and the other X-Men were made to face various deathtraps in Murderworld, the women were held prisoner but eventually released. Amanda continued to present as an ordinary person and demonstrated no magical abilities then. Eventually, Margali attempted to exact revenge for Stephan's death by constructing a facsimile of Hell as described in Dante Alighieri's epic poem Inferno as a prison for him. The X-Men, aided by Dr. Strange, sought to rescue Kurt. During the final confrontation with Margali, Jimaine intervened on Kurt's behalf. Afterwards, she revealed to Kurt that she was Amanda. With the truth revealed, Jimaine continued to use the name Amanda and work as a flight attendant while still dating Kurt. Although she was not often involved in X-Men adventures, she used her magic to aid them at some key junctures. Most notably, when the Hellfire Club invaded Xavier's school and took most of the team (and several associates, such as herself) hostage. Amanda quietly cast a spell to make it appear that Wolverine had died. This allowed Wolverine to move freely around the mansion and help turn the tide against their attackers. After an incident with the Beyonder, Nightcrawler suffered a crisis of faith. He broke up with Amanda and distanced himself from her, causing her considerable anguish. Kurt was later mortally wounded during a battle with the Marauders and was left comatose for months. The rest of the X-Men went into hiding before the conflict could be resolved. Amanda then attempted to become Doctor Strange's disciple, leading to a brief conflict between her mother Margali and the Sorcerer Supreme. After learning that Kurt had resurfaced as a member of Excalibur in the United Kingdom, Amanda traveled to Muir Island to try and find him. She was there when the island came under attack by the Reavers and joined the temporary, ad hoc team known as the Muir Island X-Men. Amanda remained at Muir until the residents were possessed by the Shadow King. After the Muir Island Saga, she gave up superheroics. Kurt called her out of retirement to help retrieve Captain Britain from the time stream. She almost managed the feat but had to exchange Rachel Summers for Brian. Kurt and Amanda then traveled to Germany where their mother had been captured by D'Spayre. They saved Margali and afterwards Amanda joined Excalibur. Later, Amanda convinced Shadowcat to give Magik's Soulsword to her mother for safekeeping. But Margali instead used it to kill every magician ahead of her on the Winding Way and then joined the London branch of the Inner Circle of the Hellfire Club as the Red Queen. After defeating Margali, Amanda parted ways from Excalibur without telling anyone. The truth was that Margali had secretly taken over her body while the true Amanda was held captive by Belasco. Amanda eventually freed herself and defeated her mother once again. She realized that someone needed to rule Limbo and took on the mantle herself. She changed her codename to Magik as a tribute to Illyana. Like Belasco had, she controlled the teleportinging "stepping discs" of Limbo through magic. The Archenemy arose out of an attempt to catalog various magics. Amanda was tricke
powers: Amanda is a sorceress following the path of the Winding Way, whose power waxes and wanes over time. This grants her powers such as: and the manipulation of other magical forces at her full disposal
fields.species: Human sorcerer; Jimaine Szardos is the daughter of the Romani sorceress Margali Szardos. She grew up in the circus with her brother Stephan and her adopted brother Kurt Wagner. She nearly left to see the world with Kurt but after an incident where Belasco killed the actress who had taken her place in the circus, she stayed with Margali to learn the Winding Way.

amanda sheridan.name: Amanda Sheridan
amanda sheridan.origin: Amanda's mother was born a slave, and her father was hung by the Ku Klux Klan. Amanda married Jacob Sheridan and stayed with him during the harsh winters of Alaska as he worked as a gold miner, starting the family fortune from scratch. At one point, Amanda may have had acrophobia. However, during one of these Alaskans cold times, a Kodiak bear harassed Jacob and Amanda, prompting them to climb a tree quickly; then the bear refused to leave, Amanda theorizing that they were the only available food, so the Sheridans were forced to kill it. Ever from that moment, Amanda lost her fear. After giving Amanda several children, Jacob died. Amanda then created and headed Sheridan Industries, a company with offices in a penthouse in Santa Ana, California. She was also honored with the treatment "Lady". Lady Amanda lived in Beverly Hills, owning a second residence in the mid-nineties of the Fifth Avenue in New York City, and employing a personal butler. She became reputed as the richest woman in the world at one time, but she claimed to only have gone the extra mile for her family, which included several adult grandchildren such as Thomas and Samantha ("Sam"), a geophysicist. The amoral weapon manufacturing concern Deterrence Research Corporation, led by ruthless CEO Moses Magnum, was hired to develop a toxic biochemical gas to be used as a weapon, and Magnum arranged for it to be tested on kidnapped innocents in an undisclosed death camp in the jungles South America. Their victims included Lady Amanda's grandson Thomas Sheridan and his family, as well as Samantha's parents, brother and baby sister, all of them dead in the swamps in unmarked graves. Lady Amanda eventually discovered about the specific gruesome effect of the gas and the pain suffered by her relatives. The Punisher and Spider-Man eventually found about the operation and stopped it, and the Punisher was believed to have killed Magnum himself (thou Magnum secretly survived and escaped), but by then the kidnapped Sheridans were already dead, even if other prisoners were released. The Deterrence Research Corporation deflected any and all responsibility for the disaster, and continued with their activities, much to Lady Amanda and Samantha Sheridan's disappointment. Lady Amanda openly craved revenge for her family, leading to conflict between Sheridan Industries and the DRC. Approximately at this point, young Eric Lazar joined the board of Sheridan Industries and earned a reputation of being trustworthy for the following six years; but at some point the DRC secretly hired Lazar so he'd work for them, infiltrated in Sheridan Industries. Lady Amanda discovered that Magnum was alive, and "working on a project of literally earth-shaking magnitude" (which was correct, Magnum was developing a machine to cause earthquakes from the area of Japan), which was likely to put her granddaughter in danger (which was again correct, as Samantha was an expert in the faults, having already detected the effects caused by Magnum's tests, and Magnum intended to abduct her to question her on the specific effects of his technology). Lady Amanda would have gone after Magnum herself if she had been young and strong enough but, as she was not, she tried to find and hire the Punisher to track and kill Magnum, only to find the Punisher "unavailable". She then sent several "normal" agents after Magnum, only for them to disappear. She then summoned superpowered hero for hire Power Man to her New York home, and offered to hire Power Man to kill Magnum - but Power Man refused. She did hire Power Man to protect Samantha against Magnum's forces, both understanding that the task may or may not require lethal force against Magnum to be fulfilled. Lady Amanda provided Power Man with a passport and a plane ticket to go to Tokyo, Japan, to meet with Samantha, who was there researching Magnum's artificial earthquakes. As predicted by Lady Amanda, Magnum did kidnap Samantha, only for her to be rescued by Power Man and for Magnum's island base to be destroyed, with him inside; secretly, however, Magnum survive again. Later, Lady Amanda and Samantha moved together to Santa Ana, California, where Samantha began helping her great-grandmother (whom she nicknamed "Gram") managing the company. Knowing that Lady Amanda had sworn to get even with the DRC, the DRC reacted by starting a corporate takeover of Sheridan Industries, so that Lady Amanda would not have resources to oppose them. The DRC decided to kidnap Lady Amanda so that she'd miss a critical board meeting where her presence was required to control the rest of Sheridan Industries board members. DRC used sent of their superhuman employees, Hammer and Anvil, to kidnap Lady Amanda in the night; however, criminologist Scotty McDowell discovered part of their plan and sent his superheroine friend Spider-Woman to patrol a certain area. During the night, Hammer and Anvil ambushed the Sheridans' Rolls-Royce, at that point driven by Samantha and with Lady A

fields.notes: When retelling the story of Power Man Annual #1, both and (Moses Magnum's profiles) mistakenly say that Power Man rescued Amanda Sheridan, hired by her grandmother. In the story, he rescues Samantha Sheridan, not Amanda, and was hired by Samantha's great-grandmother Amanda. In Power Man Annual #1, Amanda says that his grandson Thomas and his family were killed by Moses Magnum. In Spider-Woman #34, Amanda's great-granddaughter Samantha says that her parents and siblings were killed by Moses Magnum. This may be interpreted as Thomas being Samantha's father - but in that case, Amanda's sentence would be misleading, "My grandson's family, Cage -- murdered by Moses Magnum", as not all of his family had been murdered. This article thus assumes that Thomas is not Samantha's father, and that Moses killed both Thomas and Samantha's father (who was also Thomas' brother).

amanda von doom.name: Amanda von Doom
amanda von doom.origin: Amanda von Doom was the commander of the Mad Squad, a government team specializing in the elimination of dangerous scientists who had become a threat. Despite her surname, she clarified that she had no family connection to Doctor Doom. Her early life began under tragic circumstances, as her mother died in childbirth, and Amanda was born into a world associated with one of Latveria's harshest prisons. Amanda first sought the Hulk's cooperation after discovering that Bruce Banner had become dangerously unstable while attempting to recreate the accident that had originally transformed him. Banner's experiments had produced an island populated by gamma-mutated animals, and his theft of gamma materials from a military installation convinced Amanda that he had to be stopped. Although the Hulk initially refused to get involved, he eventually agreed to help, insisting that Banner would be his to deal with. Amanda and the Mad Squad subsequently confronted the scientist on his island, where they encountered his monstrous creations and discovered that he had prepared a gamma bomb. When the bomb detonated, Banner was killed, and Amanda later witnessed the Hulk mourning the remains of his former alter ego alongside the surviving creatures. She and her team were then forced to negotiate with the gamma-mutates, who demanded that the island be restored. Amanda continued to work alongside the Hulk after learning that Banner had somehow returned. When she confronted the Hulk in Antarctica, she accused him of lying about Banner's death, but soon realized that the two personalities had been reunited. The Hulk asked for her assistance in pursuing Doctor Doom, whom he believed responsible for the events that had driven Banner insane. Amanda agreed and brought him aboard the Mad Squad's ship, where she had recruited the gamma-mutated monkey encountered during Banner's experiments. She also revealed that her team had captured a Doombot connected to the scientist's island, providing the Hulk with a possible lead. During their subsequent assault on the Doombots' secret base in the African Serengeti, Amanda fought alongside the Hulk and the Mad Squad against Doom's robotic forces and their army of gamma-irradiated animals. Before the operation, she kissed the Hulk and warned him that she would castrate him with a chainsaw if he killed Doctor Doom before she had the opportunity to do so.

amar rai.name: Amar Rai
amar rai.origin: Amar Rai was a taxi driver who picked up Viv Vision at the San Diego International Airport when she went on a mission to monitor the activities of the Freelancers in Coronado. Their drive was interrupted when the Red Locust landed on top of the car's hood while chasing Mateo Garza. After disrupting the operations of a drug lab with Viv's help, the Red Locust returned to Amar and gave him some money she had taken from the drug lab to cover the repairs to his car.

amara aquilla.name: Amara Aquilla
amara aquilla.origin: ===Early Life=== Amara was born and raised in the lost colony of Nova Roma settled by the Roman Empire shortly after the death of Julius Caesar in 44 BC. Resting deep within the Amazon Jungle's of Brazil the city remained hidden for centuries. As the daughter of Senator Lucius Aquilla, her upbringing was that of privilege prestige, but not without the the looming shadows of political intrigue. Nova Roma, though secluded from the modern world, was not immune to internal strife. An Inca faction within the colony, lead by Senator Marcus Gallio under the sway of his wife the immortal witch Selene, Black Priestess, sought to usurp its republican ideals and subjugate its populace to imperial rule. Under Selene's influence, dark rituals and sacrificial ceremonies cast a pall of fear over the colony, threatening its very existence. In the midst of this turmoil, Senator Aquilla, resolute in his opposition to Selene's plans, found himself confronted with a harrowing dilemma: the safety of his beloved daughter, Amara. Recognizing the grave peril posed by Selene's faction, Senator Aquilla made a heart-wrenching decision, he orchestrated Amara's escape from Nova Roma, disguising her as a native Brazilian. Thus began Amara's journey wrought with uncertainty and solitude as she ventured beyond the confines of her homeland. Guided by her father's love and the imperative of survival, she navigated the untamed wilderness, her identity concealed from those who sought to do her harm. ===New Mutants=== Amara remained in hiding for years until she was captured by the New Mutants, who were on an expedition in the Amazon jungle. They learned of her disguise, but then both Amara and the New Mutants were captured by soldiers of Nova Roma and imprisoned. Now held prisoner by Selene, Amara was to be sacrificed. Selene used her mutant powers to drain Amara's life energy into her own body. The New Mutant, Mirage, attacked Selene. This distraction caused Selene to release Amara from her control, but Selene knocked Amara into a pit of lava. Somehow, rather than harming Amara, her immersion in the lava awakened her latent mutant powers. Together, Amara, with her new-found powers, and the New Mutants defeated Selene and helped thwart Senator Gallio's attempt to kill Senator Aquilla and seize power. Amara was instructed to go to the United States with the New Mutants and there learn about modern civilization. Amara did so, reluctantly, and became a member of the New Mutants, under the code-name Magma. In the Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters, the New Mutants were tutored, by Professor X, and trained in the use of their powers, in the Danger Room. At first, Magma experienced culture shock, however, she soon got a handle of modern civilization, including such things as computers and electricity. Amara also made quick progress in the use of her powers, being able to melt tunnels into the ground with the walls cooling down in mere seconds. As a form of payback, Empath turned Amara and Sunspot over to the Gladiators where they are forced to battle for entertainment by a former New Mutant, Karma. Later, Amora the Enchantress kidnapped the New Mutants to Asgard. While attempting to escape, Magik used her teleportation discs and the Enchantress' magic affected the destination and the New Mutants were separated through time and space. Amara ended-up in Svartalfheim and was seduced and transformed into a fairy by the Dark Elves. amara king.name: Amara King
amara king.origin: Amara was a CIA undercover agent who was supposed to investigate Garrick King. To this end, she went so far as to seduce him and then marry him. She has since begun a surveillance operation on her husband, overhearing her conversations with the Shroud when the latter tried to get Garrick to work for him. Amara contacted her superiors at the CIA after there were complications leading to Scorpion's near death of Garrick and after Inspector Korngold suspected Garrick's criminal activities. Amara later confessed to Shroud that she was a CIA agent and was guarding Garrick on behalf of the Agency after he had stolen $2 million counterfeit dollars from the CIA. She also tried to seduce Shroud, but he rebuffed her. Amara was taken hostage by Lassiter and the Scorpion to convince Garrick to hand over the $2 million dollars, then the Shroud intervened who with a ruse made Amara persuade Garrick to transfer the money, but when the Shroud arrived to save Garrick, he betrayed him by delivering him to the Cult of Kali and when Garrick tried to escape, Amanda killed him by shooting him with a gun.

amara perera.name: Amara Perera
amara perera.origin: Dr. Amara Perera is a brilliant biophysicist who was born and raised on the island of Sri Lanka. Amara had developed a cure for the mutant gene that theoretically prevented Mutants from receiving their abilities, but hadn't dared to create it due to the political and sociological aftermath that would surely occur if she did. She met Tony Stark at a conference in Dubai. Some time later, they had a date in New York City, where she explained her discovery to Stark, but didn't wanted to use it. The date was interrupted when Stark's A.I. assistant Friday notified him of the sighting of Madame Masque in Latveria. left|thumb Following a life-threatening encounter with Madame Masque, Tony visited Amara in her laboratory and opened up to her, and they shared their first kiss. They started dating shortly after, but their relationship ended after Tony faked his own death to infiltrate a clan of bio-tech ninja in Japan. After that she returned to Sri Lanka and lived with Tharik Baas. During Stark's absence, his newfound ally, the reformed Victor von Doom, began to pay attention to Amara, and even set her up a laboratory in Cambridge University and kept her off the grid. When Tony eventually returned, he apologized to Amara and tried to reconnect with her, but she rejected him, feeling he had been cruel of letting her believe he had truly died. Following Tony's fall into a coma, Victor continued visiting Amara, despite her opposition, turning her into his reluctant confidante. Amara's apartment was even destroyed when S.H.I.E.L.D. agent The Thing interrupted an encounter between she and Victor, which resulted in a fight. Amara's unwilling connection with Doom also caught the attention of S.H.I.E.L.D., who would barge into her place of work for questioning more than once, which resulted in her being fired. Not long afterwards, Amara began feeling symptoms of pregnancy. Her friend, a physician named Keren, ran tests and shared with Amara that she was indeed pregnant. It would later be mentioned by Doom that the child didn't survive to term.

amass.name: Amass
amass.origin: ===Threshold=== === War with the Unbreathing and Death === Amass is a mutant of the Threshold. On the declining of their society, caused by the war with the Unbreathing and the massacre caused by the sentient bacteria Sublime and Arkea. Grove selected Amass along with Crave and Theia as a trio whose powers would allow them to transcend time to either find help or preserve their history if help wasn't possible, the Threshold Three. The Threshold Three locked themselves in one body, thanks to Amass' powers, and were launched through time with Theia's powers as a living time capsule. . Unfortunately, the Shi'ar order known as the Kin Crimson foresaw the Threshold Three's attempt and so they intercepted them and they were vaporized. However, the Kin preserved their combined DNA in a timedrive that was stored on the Shi'ar equipment stolen by Magneto to complete Avalon. === Theft of the Timedrive and Resurrection === After 2 billion years, the Marauders, who had time-travelled to the destruction of Avalon, managed to recover the timedrive and erase the memories of the parties involved in the destruction, the Acolytes and Nemesis. A few days later, on Krakoa, even though their DNA had degraded, Cerebra used her powers to reconfigure the sequence and summoned the Five to resurrect the Threshold Three. After they were resurrected, the Marauders informed them of what had happened to them and they told them of Threshold's history. === Time-Travel to Threshold === With the Marauders, the Threshold Three travelled back to ancient Threshold. Unfortunately, they were unable to save Threshold. After returning to the future, Captain Pryde commissioned the resurrection of the Threshold Three because they had died 2 billions year ago but the records of their DNA and Cerebro backups were still on present-day Krakoa. ===War College=== Amass was recommended by the Quiet Council of Krakoa and the Great Captains to be tutored by Bishop as part of his War College operation. Bishop's method involved intensive and ruthless exercises, raising tensions between him and his pupils. Bishop eventually readapted his method with Tempo's help, earning his cadets' approval. However, they were unexpectedly attacked by the Fenris during their training and Bishop was inadvertently transported by Tempo to Earth-63. The Fenris used Blightswill to weaken the young mutants and their power went out of control. in a fight between Andreas Von Strucker and Cam Long they both got absorbed into Amass, and they started attacking Andrea. Andrea managed to divide the three and Amass and Cam were both caught by Orchis but were freed by their team members, who got their powers back just in time for Bishop and Tempo to come back. They all fought Orchis together and left Fenris in the Pit. Then they all graduated from War College and Amass got a B+, with notes from Bishop about the fact that Amass has good potential but he's not ready to fight in a group yet.

amaterasu.name: Amaterasu
amaterasu.origin: ===Origins=== Amaterasu is a member of an extra-dimensional race of beings known as the Amatsu-Kami ("Heavenly Ones") who were worshipped as gods by the Ancient Ainu and Japanese people in Eastern Asia. She is one of a trinity of gods at a large hierarchy of deities along with Susanoo, the storm-god, and Tsukuyomi, the moon-god. left|thumb|Amaterasu ===Third Host=== In 1000 AD, the Third Host of the Celestials occurred, during which the aliens informed they would return 1,000 years later to judge Earth's right to continue existing. While the pantheons prepared for war, Gaea planned a peaceful solution to the problem with many goddesses, among them Amaterasu. For the next thousand years, they searched for humans representing mankind's highest ideals, to be offered to the Celestials as an offering. The goddesses placed the candidates in suspended animation, with their superhuman potential, the legacy of the First Host, awakened. ===Modern Times=== In modern times, the mutant adventurer Wolverine referred to Japan as “the Land of Amaterasu.” ===Chaos War=== right|thumb|Amaterasu vs. Mikaboshi Amaterasu represented the Amatsu-Kami in the Council of Godheads after Mikaboshi and his army of enslaved alien deities attacked Earth. Although the Asgardian representative Balder wanted to rush into battle against Mikaboshi in order assist the Earth realm, Amaterasu instead sealed off the Council’s throne room in order to safeguard the various pantheons and their respective divine realms from an attack by Mikaboshi. However, the Olympian god Hercules inadvertently enabled Mikaboshi to enter the throne room when he brought the body of his fallen father Zeus (then under Mikaboshi’s influence) to the Council of Godheads’ hidden extradimensional realm, allowing Mikaboshi’s army to attack all of the god realms in rapid succession. When Mikaboshi attacked the Amatsu-Kami’s home realm of Ama, Amaterasu led her fellow Shinto gods (including Inari, Ame-No-Mi-Kumari, Bishamon, Kaminari, and Hotei) in a valiant counterattack which ultimately failed. While the pantheons prepared for war, Gaea planned a peaceful solution to the problem with many goddesses, among them Amaterasu. For the next thousand years, they searched for humans representing mankind's highest ideals, to be offered to the Celestials as an offering. amatsu mikaboshi.origin: ===Origin=== The entity known as Amatsu-Mikaboshi originated as an aspect of Oblivion, the abstract entity embodying the void that existed before the universe even began. An incarnation of the primordial darkness and chaos that existed before the universe, the Chaos King existed as a dark counterpart to Eternity, whose genesis stripped the Chaos King of much of its power and led to it being integrated into the Shinto cosmology as "Amatsu-Mikaboshi." According to Shinto cosmology, Amatsu-Mikaboshi ruled over the Earth all alone when it was nothing more than a formless void of primordial darkness, until the elder goddess known as Gaea--in the form of Izanami--and a young Amatsu-Kami called Izanagi created the islands of Japan from the Void using the divine Jeweled Spear, and populated it with their divine children the lesser Amatsu-Kami--who later came to be worshipped as gods by the humans of Japan. The dark god was enraged that his void was now gone and he wasn't the only being in existence anymore, and so he declared war on Izanami, Izanagi, and the Amatsu-Kami. He was ultimately imprisoned in the netherworld of Yomi, where he remained for centuries, which he spent accruing an army of oni, shinma demons, and other evil spirits and monsters inhabiting the underworld. ===Warriors Three=== The Warriors Three were put on trial for accidentally killing a giant who had shapeshifted into an aquatic beast. As punishment, they were sentenced to retrieve several difficult items from various pantheons and return them to the father of the dead giant. This included the mystical sword known as the Grasscutter from Yomi, which was guarded by Amatsu-Mikaboshi and his subjects. thumb|left|Amatsu-Mikaboshi influencing Alexander Aaron (Earth-616)|Alexander Aaron ===Creation of the Ebon Samurai=== Following his at hands of the Silver Samurai, Japanese police officer Kioshi Keishicho ended up in Yomi, where Amatsu-Mikaboshi sensed his arrival and approached him with an offer to resurrect Kioshi so that he could seek revenge. When Kioshi accepted the offer, Mikaboshi bonded him to a shinma demon that manifested as a black suit of samurai armor and a katana capable of cutting through almost anything, but at the cost of corrupting its user everytime he unsheathed it while also constantly reminding Kioshi of the debt he owed to the evil god. ===Ares: God of War=== Taking advantage of the chaos left by the fall of Asgard and the Norse pantheon, Amatsu-Mikaboshi planned to extend his influence by capturing Olympus and crushing the Olympian gods. With the Olympians defeated, Mikaboshi hoped to compel all of the other pantheons into surrendering to him. To this end, Mikaboshi laid siege to Olympus, which was very close to succeeding. Ares, still bitter about the treatment he had received from the other Olympians, refused to raise even a finger to help them. Desperate for his aid and wishing to goad Ares into action, Zeus had his son Alexander Aaron kidnapped and brought to Olympus, where he was placed under the care of Achilles and his Myrmidons. With Mikaboshi in utter control of the battle, Hermes went to Earth to fetch an enraged Ares in an attempt to get him to speak with Zeus, but Ares' only concern was his son. Relenting, Hermes transported them both to Achilles' stronghold where they kept Alexander, only to find the fortress destroyed and Alexander missing. While Achilles was away, Mikaboshi's forces managed to destroy the Myrmidons' fortress and steal Alexander away to his own stronghold in the eastern lands. Mikaboshi slowly began to warp and poison Alexander's mind in an attempt to turn him against his father by revealing the brutal history and patricides committed by the Greek gods. Mikaboshi hoped to turn Alexander into the new god of war, one that could be used against the Olympian gods and, more importantly, Ares himself. thumb|right|Fighting Phoebus Apollo (Earth-616)|Apollo Finding out his son was in the hands of Olympus' enemies, a furious Ares begrudgingly agreed to join in the fighting, but only to rescue his son, nothing more. Taking the appearance of Alexander, Mikaboshi approached Zeus who was unable to see through his disguise, and with his guard lowered the evil god pierced the Skyfather's chest and ripped his heart out. He then bestowed Grasscutter to Alexander with the intention of using it against Ares. The night before the final battle, the evil lord of dreams, Nightmare allowed Ares to talk to Mikaboshi in their dreams, and at first the evil god suggested that they could become allies, but since it was clear that both of them had no interest in a possible alliance, the two fought, until Mikaboshi attacked Nightmare which ended the dream. During the final battle, Mikaboshi managed to overwhelm most of the Olympians, forcing the Kami to eventually come to their aid, though even their added help wasn't enough. On the brink of death once more, Zeus used his remaining power to break the hold that Mikaboshi had

fields.notes: Amatsu-Mikaboshi is not the entity's true name, merely the name that he was given by the Japanese. Amatsu-Mikaboshi is based on the of Japanese mythology and the god of the Japanese race known as the , and speaks only in haiku. Amatsu-Mikaboshi is said by Fred Van Lente as "who some see as the Japanese god of evil, but he really is a being that represents the polar opposite of the core values in the Shinto religion." In , the Defenders travel back to the Third Cosmos and help destroy the Anti-All, a primordial manifestation of nothingness, shattering it into countless fragments. Doctor Strange theorizes that the pieces of the Anti-All's essence scattered across the multiverse and that when the heroes fight against "the great Nothing" in their own times, they are fighting back against the Anti-All as well, implying that dark entities like Amatsu-Mikaboshi were born out of the Anti-All's fractured essence. How this relates to the statement that it is an aspect of Oblivion is unknown, though Hela's statement in that Oblivion is the ultimate true embodiment of the Void and that Knull and Void-born entities like him are merely "of" it suggests that the Anti-All may have been an aspect of Oblivion embodying the Void between the Second and Third Cosmoses, akin to how the Chaos King was an aspect of Oblivion embodying the Void between the Sixth and Seventh Cosmoses.
fields.trivia: Amatsu-Mikaboshi seems to incorporate elements of the Cthulhu Mythos, especially from those of . Both were portrayed as omnipotent black beings that were referred to as Chaos Kings. When asked if Amatsu-Mikaboshi could be considered a progenitor of the symbiotes alongside Knull due to being the personification of the abyss the dark elder god made them from, editor Jordan D. White really liked the idea, but did not confirm it.

amazing baby.name: Amazing Baby
amazing baby.origin: Planning to hunt them, Cullen Bloodstone purchased the five captive Warwolves from the London Zoo. However, • --|A|-- • required the skulls of all the remaining Warwolves on Earth for a magic spell and sent Captain Britain and Excalibur to procure the skulls from Bloodstone. Unknown to all, one of the Warwolves was pregnant and gave birth to a Warwolf puppy during the hunt. Finding herself unable to kill the pup, Captain Britain gave him to Rachel Grey. After joining the newly commissioned X-Factor, Rachel moved with Amazing Baby into the Boneyard. Rachel has been training Amazing Baby to be a tracker.

amazo.name: Amazo
amazo.origin: Amazo was an stage illusionist who was active in the 1940s. He worked for producer Jim Markham, who cancelled Amazo's show in 1946. Driven insane by this, Amazo then kidnapped Markham with the intention of torturing and killing him. As coincidence would have it, Amazo was interrupted by a visit from Jeff Mace and Fred Davis Jr.. The pair were attempting to call on the parents of one of Jeff' students whose grades were failing. They were unaware that the student had given them the wrong address in order to avoid trouble. Amazo, not wishing to be disturbed told the two men that he would tell his "son" to study better and slammed the door in their face. Down the street Jeff and Fred ran into the student and learned the truth and doubled back to find out what was going on at the house. They arrived just as Amazo began his torture of Markham, forcing him into a wicker basket and stabbing swords into it. Unaware that the basket had a false bottom and Markham was dropped into the basement, Jeff and Fred attacked as Captain America and Bucky. During the fight Amazo made Bucky disappear under his cape (another trap door trick) and then seemingly disappeared before Captain America's eyes (through yet another trap door). Cap was soon waylaid by one of Amazo's men hiding in a suit of armor and tied up in the basement with Amazo's other prisoners. There Amazo explained his revenge scheme and how his tricks worked. This gave Captain America enough time to free himself and attack. The fight was brief as Amazo made the mistake of grabbing a prop gun that only shot flowers and was quickly knocked out and turned over to the authorities.

fields.history: Amazo was an stage illusionist who was active in the 1940s. He worked for producer Jim Markham, who cancelled Amazo's show in 1946. Driven insane by this, Amazo then kidnapped Markham with the intention of torturing and killing him. As coincidence would have it, Amazo was interrupted by a visit from Jeff Mace and Fred Davis Jr.. The pair were attempting to call on the parents of one of Jeff' students whose grades were failing. They were unaware that the student had given them the wrong address in order to avoid trouble. Amazo, not wishing to be disturbed told the two men that he would tell his "son" to study better and slammed the door in their face. Down the street Jeff and Fred ran into the student and learned the truth and doubled back to find out what was going on at the house. They arrived just as Amazo began his torture of Markham, forcing him into a wicker basket and stabbing swords into it. Unaware that the basket had a false bottom and Markham was dropped into the basement, Jeff and Fred attacked as Captain America and Bucky. amber mutant.name: Amber (Mutant)
amber mutant.origin: Amber was one of 19 young mutants who were accepted to Empire State University when that institution actively opened its doors to mutants. Her power consisted into shape-shifting which manifested usually during her dreams, according to her parents' observations. Amber avoided joining the local Students for Tolerance group ran by Gigi Martin, as well as the fringe Magnetic North, and claimed to have joined the university for the free education, and only joined the chess club. Amber met Chamber, who had recently enrolled at ESU. She noticed his attraction to Gigi Martin, and cautioned him about getting involved with her. Chamber met with Amber and revealed to her that he was one of the X-Men, having gone undercover to learn how six of the mutant classmates had died. Later, he visited her dorm room and briefly saw her in her form as a beautiful blonde woman. Amber claimed that that person was her roommate. She assisted him in investigating the mutant-hate group Purity, using her computer, and managed to track down one of the group's members. Later that evening, Chamber entered Amber's room from her window and again beheld her as her "roommate". Amber quickly covered for herself claiming that she had changed rooms. Chamber revealed to her that the man from Purity said that the killer of the six students was a mutant himself. The next day, Amber accompanied Chamber to the scene of the murders. Guessing that a member of Magnetic North might be behind the murders, Chamber was just setting off to see them when Amber kissed him. Chamber reacted badly to this, as he only thought of Amber as a friend. Hurt, Amber told him to leave. After learning from Magnetic North that the mutant who killed the others was, in fact, Gigi Martin's boyfriend and co-founder of the Student for Tolerance: Alex, he broke into Gigi's office to find her holding a gun on Amber, trying to coerce Amber into staying out of the investigation. Having realized what Amber's power was, Chamber communicated with her telepathically, and had her assume the form of Gigi's dead lover Alex. This distracted Gigi long enough for Chamber to disarm her, ending the crisis. With the case solved, Amber explained to Chamber that her "roommate's" form was one she must have dreamed about. Impressed with her looks, Chamber tried to kiss her, but she responded by slapping him. Indignant that even someone as unusual as him could be so ruled by appearances, she thanked him for saving her life, but asked to never see him again. Chamber later learned that all of the mutant students had been expelled from ESU except for Amber. He felt she would be an excellent ambassador to humanity. She was depowered due to M-Day and was most likely killed on the bus when it exploded.

amber griffen.name: Amber Griffen
amber griffen.origin: Amber Griffen was the daughter of Ryan Griffen, a member of the US Secret Service. As a child, Amber struggled in school and eventually transferred to a new one. On her first day, her father was killed by X-23 on her first mission. Years later, Amber joined the Orphans of X, an organization consisting of surviving family members to those killed by products of the Weapon X program. She became romantically involved with Henry Sutter, another member orphaned by X-23. The Orphans of X were enraged when Laura Kinney (now going by "Wolverine") was publicly honored as a hero for her role in saving the residents of Roosevelt Island, and made it their mission to hunt down and kill the remaining Wolverines. Amber and Henry promised each other that when they killed X-23, they would pull the trigger together. The Orphans of X successfully hunted down and killed Old Man Logan, Daken, Sabretooth, and Lady Deathstrike using Muramasa Bullets, which their healing factors were powerless against. Laura and her clone "sister", Gabby, tracked down the four killed and were able to revive them by cutting away the damaged tissue and letting them heal normally. Soon after, Laura confronted the Orphans of X, wearing the Muramasa Armor, which made her impervious to their bullets. However, Laura removed her armor and was made vulnerable before them. She forced Henry to admit his father's role in her upbringing (something he'd neglected to tell Amber) and calmly stated that she no longer held herself responsible for the murders she'd been forced to commit as an exploited child. Laura managed to convince Amber and the other Orphans that they were all victims of the same system and promised to help them track down and bring to justice every person who'd paid for her services as an assassin, proclaiming herself to be an Orphan of X. Some time later, Laura visited Amber to tell her she'd tracked down Chad Newman, the man who'd ordered the hit on Senator Greg Johnson, which led to Amber's father being killed. Amber and Laura traveled to Vanuatu, where Newman had fled after the assassination. Newman immediately was made aware of Amber's arrival and ordered his guards to take her into custody, which they did. After Laura tracked them down, Newman recognized her and threatened to fire on civilians unless she stood down. It was then that Amber revealed that X-23 had not come back for revenge, but she had. Amber electrocuted him while Laura immobilized the guards and they both stuffed Newman in a suitcase. They hauled the suitcase onto a speed boat and drove into international water, preparing to be picked up. Before turning in Newman, Amber took out a pair to boots to use to stomp on him with. She also invited Laura to join, reasoning that he had played a role in destroying both of their childhoods, and they opened the suitcase and stomped on him together.

amber silverstein.name: Amber Silverstein
amber silverstein.origin: thumb|left|200px|Amber SilversteinAmber Silverstein first met Nadia Van Dyne in Times Square while the latter was attempting to recruit Priya Aggarwal to join G.I.R.L.. The pair bonded over a love for science, but soon parted at Nadia went off to meet Shay Smith. Nadia attempted to find Amber again, to recruit her to join Pym Labs as well, but to no avail. She later learned Amber had taken the alias Seeker and was working for A.I.M. to steal an artifact from Horizon Labs, which they believed to be vital in stopping Hank Pym from spreading the Ultron Virus. Amber took part in the assault on Pym Labs by A.I.M., where she personally attempted to kidnap Shay and steal her prototype teleporter. Amber was confronted by Ying, who threatened her, but ultimately it was Shay who engaged Amber's jetpack and caused her to abandon her goal. Amber then led the other A.I.M. lieutenants to a waiting blimp where they made their getaway. Amber and A.I.M. later attacked the G.I.R.L. Expo at the Javits Convention Center. Amber assisted in the attack, capturing Priya, but later fought and was beaten by Nadia. When Monica made a getaway by blowing up Shay's portal, Nadia saved Amber from being sucked into the vacuum. It was then revealed the Amber had been convinced to join the team by Monica, who told Amber that Nadia was working with Ultron. In the aftermath of the G.I.R.L. Expo, Amber was offered a position as part of G.I.R.L., which she accepted.
