amy bendix.name: Amy Bendix
amy bendix.origin: Amy was the mentally challenged daughter of Sheriff Bendix. When the Punisher was on the run from organized crime after killing a member of the Vaducci Family and making his way out alive but wounded, he found himself in the town of Laastekist, where he befriended Amy who housed him in her tree house, but her father managed to find out and thinking that the Punisher's intentions were bad, he arrested him by locking him in a cell of his prison. After being arrested, he tried to tell the sheriff who he was and that all the criminal groups would go there to kill him, but the sheriff did not believe him, instead it happened just what the Punisher had predicted and amid the chaos that followed, a group of criminals went to Bendix's house and took Amy as a hostage, having her tell her father over the radio that they would not hurt her if he let the Punisher out of the cell. After much insistence, Sheriff Bendix agreed to free the Punisher in order to save his daughter. After having stunned the sheriff to prevent him from getting involved in the firefight, the Punisher went to the Sheriff's house and vanquished the criminals who were there waiting for him to kill him, in the meantime Amy managed to escape by escaping from a hatch on the roof and fleeing into the woods but was captured by a V.I.G.I.L. Agent who was willing to commit a criminal act to capture the Punisher. In a stalemate, since Amy didn't want the Punisher to kill the agent, after the Punisher knocked his weapon to the ground, the V.I.G.I.L. agent about to shoot him but at that moment Sheriff Bendix intervened who shot the agent killing him and let the Punisher go free for what he had seen him do to help Amy. During the confrontation between the Punisher, the organized crime and V.I.G.I.L., Sheriff Bendix takes Amy to her neighbor's house and asks her to lock herself and her daughter up in her bomb shelter.

amy brewer.name: Amy Brewer
amy brewer.species: Mutant whose powers activated upon death.
amy brewer.origin: Amy Brewer was engaged to marry Malcolm Codsworth. After the rehearsal of the wedding, the couple was served roast duck but Malcolm was too nervous to eat. Amy died of food poisoning that night. At least, her body did, her mind continued to be aware. Even after she was buried, she was still conscious. Several days after her burial, her anger literally forced her body to move. She escaped her plot and discovered that she could animate the dead. She decided that it was the time she married Malcolm and after some preparations, she kidnapped him and several other residents. X-Factor was called in to investigate after two local police officers were killed when they entered the cemetery. Alpha Flight, on their World Tour '92, accompanied X-Factor. After an initial confrontation when Amy attempted to destroy both teams for disturbing her wedding, Jeanne-Marie was able to convince Malcolm that love was not something that death controlled. The ceremony took place and Amy Brewer died in her husband's arms.

amy chen.name: Amy Chen
amy chen.first_appearance: Silver Sable and the Wild Pack Vol 1 2
amy chen.origin: Amy Chen was born in Vietnam into an environment rich in poverty and death. Her parents were executed before she could meet them. Chen was sold as a slave on the black market and, at the age of ten, she was forced to work in agriculture, receiving daily beatings with the excuse of discipline; she possibly suffered other types of abuse too. Still ten, she decided to cause pain rather than suffer it, and she murdered her foreman with a piece of bamboo that she prepared as a weapon. She found that killing was easy and pleasant for her, and she took a piece of the corpse as a souvenir. She decided to keep a piece of every person she killed. thumb|right|Chen wore a necklace with parts of the people she murdered. Over the next five years, Chen went from assassin to prostitute, first working in Vietnam, and then becoming a high-priced prostitute in a bar in Bangkok. She murdered more people, keeping parts of their bodies that she kept on a necklace, although there were only rumors that she had killed one. A client wearing a pretty ring proposed Chen a career change as an assassin working for an unnamed Guild for life, but Chen would have to "buy her freedom" by earning a lot of money or by murdering the man who managed her job at the time. She chose the second option, and over the next few years she grew into one of the best assassins in Southeast Asia. Other employers offered Chen membership in their groups, but the Guild in which Chen was a member punished desertion with death. Eventually, Chen killed the man who had gotten her into the Guild, taking his ring finger for herself. Throughout her career, Chen murdered almost all of her former employers. The Guild expanded its activities to the United States of America, where Chen worked for them. In America, the Guild became part of the 1400 Club, a criminal organization controlled by the Foreigner. fields.personality: Chen grew up in an abusive environment until she decided to cause pain instead of receiving it, and redirected her career from a prostitute to a professional assassin, working for other interests. She eventually vowed never to be controlled again and began working for Silver Sable's Wild Pack, a team of elite mercenaries. Chen took her job very seriously, with a no-nonsense attitude and, although she berated her colleagues for what he perceived as unprofessionalism, she also counted on them to cover each other in combat situations. Chen's authoritarian, domineering behavior, considering that she was not the commanding officer of her unit, was compared to Sable's cold and stern behavior. Chen was well informed of what was happening in her group, both with her companions and with potential enemies. Like Sable, Chen made jokes in combat much more infrequently than the rest of her companions. thumb|left|Chen is likely to have had romantic feelings for Silver Sable. It is true that Chen had great respect and loyalty for Sable, and possibly felt a romantic attraction towards her; Chen addressed Sable as "M'lady" and only occasionally called her Silver; Chen's previous boss in the assassins guild, Maria, had been the only person Chen called "M'lady" before, and Maria speculated that Chen "fell for her (Sable) too", suggesting that Chen had had a romantic relationship with Maria before and was interested in having another one with Sable. Sable cared for Chen and was willing to do things she didn't like to protect Chen, but only described Chen as an investment (although she admitted she wasn't just a financial investment). Chen also expressed admiration for the physical appearance of another female companion, Lightbright. The Crippler, Chen's teammate, concluded that Chen was homosexual and would never be romantically interested in a man; her other teammate Doug Powell, unable to take the hint, tried to seduce Chen several times, only to be flatly (and aggressively) rejected. When the Crippler tried to explain to Powell that Chen was not rejecting him for personal reasons, Chen corrected him by explaining that, in that case, and even if she was homosexual, she rejected Powell for personal reasons, especially because Powell displayed a racist attitude that offended the Vietnamese Chen. However, Chen impressed Powell with her combat capabilities and the two were able to work together efficiently. As for the Crippler, Chen had quickly understood that he was a sadomasochist, and she reproached him for behaviors that endangered others and for his childish humor. Another teammate was Quentino, whom Chen watched cough in Somalia and was on top of him to make sure he could do his job. In recent times, Chen worked with other Symkaria groups without Sable's direct collaboration. When Chen was murdered before Sable's eyes, Sable screamed in horror, although if they ever had a romantic relationship, it has never been revealed.
fields.notes: Chen's origin is related to the last days of the Vietnam War (1955-1975), which is a case of Sliding Timescale. When the comic was published (1994), this suggested that Chen was born in the early 1970s and was thus in her early 20s. The story mentions that Chen's parents had died as "suspected sympathizers" and that American soldiers had sold young Chen as a slave in the black market. Considering Chen's romantic interest in Sable, it is surprising that she never interacted with Sable's lover at the time, Jacques Girard (who she could have approached in Somalia, like Powell did, or when Girard picked up Sable for a date in the Embassy); nor with the porn magazine that supposedly showed Sable (which her teammates did find). Chen did mention how she'd have liked to slash Sable's sometimes-lover the Foreigner after Sable beat him but allowed to live, but admittedly Chen had a different score to settle with the Foreigner as Chen's only living ex-employer. Both Chen and Sable refer to the Chen's crossbow's projectiles as "arrows", while the typical words for them are bolts or quarrels.
fields.trivia: While Chen was strongly hinted to be homosexual and interested in Silver Sable (as described in her "Personality" section in this same article), the word "homosexual" and its synonyms were avoided in all of her appearances - e.g. in , the Crippler was made to shut up before he could say Chen was homosexual. Chen was said to have killed every one of her ex-employers, except for one: the Foreigner, whom she tried to kill thrice, and failed. Details of all these murders and attempts, are unrevealed. Chen was apparently a frequent customer of Club Apocalypse, where she dealt with Bolo, Izzy, Jake and possibly Frenchie; but she was only seen visiting the place once. Chen was only heard cursing once.

amy kearse.name: Amy Kearse
amy kearse.origin: Amy Kearse was the wife of Agent Aaron Kearse and mother of their son Matthew. Having grown up in a family that mostly avoided discussing the growing mutant population, Amy had an anti-mutant uncle that her family thought was crazy. After her husband joined the Mutant Civil Rights Task Force, Amy remained by his side for support and gave him a drawing their son had done of Aaron helping a fallen mutant. When her husband took a mission involving their son's baseball player hero Tony Robb, who was a secretly a mutant, Amy helped ease Aaron's worries about what to teach their son about mutants and how the Bible had no explanation for mutants. Later, after Aaron was suddenly injured while trying to disarm a bomb that threatened to blow up the Xavier Institute in order to start a war between humans and mutants, Amy remained by her husband's side at the hospital, explaining how the X-Men were the ones that disarmed the bomb and gave Aaron a new cybernetic arm as thanks for Aaron's services.

amy kwitny.origin: ===Early Life=== Born in Vietnam, Amy Tran Kwitny was the result of a brief affair between her soldier father and Vietnamese mother during the Vietnam War. When her mother was killed in a bombing run on her village, she made her way to America, hoping to find her father. Instead, she wound up living in various shelters. Selected as part of the MK Ultra phase of development by Aladdin, she was subjected to several mind control experiments which erased her memory, then set free and tracked. When UltraTech first developed its corporate spokesman, Prototype, the Choice Corporation decided to follow its lead and develop its own Ultra spokes-model. When Choice Corporation CEO Bob Dixon decided he wanted someone off the street that could be groomed and controlled, his friend J.D. Hunt offered to help, using his company, NuWare, who had made progress in creating Ultras. While early experiments only lead to physical enhancements, progress made by Aladdin had shown that other enhancements were possible. With the only active Ultras at the time being the Squad, Aladdin was desperate to get them for experimentation. While plans were made, they ultimately proved pointless when the creature NM-E attacked the group, leaving DJ Blast dead, Forsa seemingly dead, and Starburst in a coma. Aladdin discovered Forsa's body half-a-mile away (unconscious; though he died soon after) and took it to their research facility in Groom Lake for study, where they managed to isolate the portion of his brain that controlled his powers. An agreement between NuWare and Aladdin was then made, resulting in them pooling their information. Rounding up the MK Ultra subjects, Kwitny was chosen from them because of her appealing looks. Cosmetic surgery was performed to remove the epicanthic fold, but otherwise she was left physically unchanged. When the only unharmed member of the Squad, Hardcase was busy filming a movie, undercover agents from Aladdin abducted his fiance, Starburst, from her hospital bed, taking her back to Groom Lake and then taking certain pieces of brain tissue from her. Putting Kwitny under the knife, they removed sections of her brain and replaced them with sections from the brains of Starburst and Forsa along with biochips in an early wetware experiment. The brain tissue from the Squad members gave her her powers (along with the additions of super-strength and enhanced senses), but the biochips imposed limitations, preventing her from using her powers for more than an hour, then requiring her to wait two hours before using them again, and forcing her to name the power she wanted to use. Putting her through a series of tests following the surgery, the experiment was found to be a success and her past was erased from her memory, and several "back door routines" (key phrases that would place her under the control of the speaker) were implanted. Confident that her powers were working, Aladdin and NuWare released her into the custody of Bob Dixon, who gave her a costume she was conditioned to always wear. Dixon then began using her as both a spokes-model and a mistress, similar to how J.D. Hunt used his android Candy. Her work as a spokesmodel initially met with great success, with the Choice Corporation using her to advertise numerous products they produced. Their initial plan called for an eventual staged incident that would make her powers public, but her conditioning began failing, causing her to vaguely remember names and begin disobeying Dixon's orders. On her way to a remote facility in Brazil, she escaped and returned to Los Angeles where the dormant memories of Starburst led her to the home of Hardcase. ===Meeting Hardcase=== Dodging Interceptors (men in powered armor) sent by the Choice Corporation, she arrived on Hardcase's balcony. They fended off the Interceptors and decide to pay a visit to the Choice corporation. They are ambushed by The Omega Team, whom they defeat. Teaming with The Strangers, Choice and Hardcase attempted to infiltrate the Groom Lake Base of Aladdin (thinking Aladdin was responsible for sending the creature that killed the Squad, NM-E, but were captured. After an escape and battle, Atom Bob threatens to erase Aladdin's data unless they agree to a "non-aggression pact" with Hardcase, Choice and the Strangers. Returning to Los Angeles, Hardcase and Choice visit the Choice Corporation. Due to her conditioning, Choice could not speak publicly against the Choice Corporation, but could speak to Hardcase in private. After a night on the town, Hardcase is nearly killed by Hardwire but he is held off by Choice, who rushes Hardcase to a hospital. The two later defeat him. ===Break-Thru=== Choice and Hardcase meet with The Alternate, who tells Hardcase where his powers come from, and who sent the NM-E after The Squad. She tasks them with retrieving an object from the moon, and in return she will give them each five million dollars and help Choice find out where her powers came from. Choice and Hardcase are in

Aladdin discovered Forsa's body half-a-mile away (unconscious; though he died soon after) and took it to their research facility in Groom Lake for study, where they managed to isolate the portion of his brain that controlled his powers. An agreement between NuWare and Aladdin was then made, resulting in them pooling their information. Rounding up the MK Ultra subjects, Kwitny was chosen from them because of her appealing looks. Cosmetic surgery was performed to remove the epicanthic fold, but otherwise she was left physically unchanged. When the only unharmed member of the Squad, Hardcase was busy filming a movie, undercover agents from Aladdin abducted his fiance, Starburst, from her hospital bed, taking her back to Groom Lake and then taking certain pieces of brain tissue from her. Putting Kwitny under the knife, they removed sections of her brain and replaced them with sections from the brains of Starburst and Forsa along with biochips in an early wetware experiment. The brain tissue from the Squad members gave her her powers (along with the additions of super-strength and enhanced senses), but the biochips imposed limitations, preventing her from using her powers for more than an hour, then requiring her to wait two hours before using them again, and forcing her to name the power she wanted to use. Putting her through a series of tests following the surgery, the experiment was found to be a success and her past was erased from her memory, and several "back door routines" (key phrases that would place her under the control of the speaker) were implanted. Confident that her powers were working, Aladdin and NuWare released her into the custody of Bob Dixon, who gave her a costume she was conditioned to always wear. Dixon then began using her as both a spokes-model and a mistress, similar to how J.D. Hunt used his android Candy. Her work as a spokesmodel initially met with great success, with the Choice Corporation using her to advertise numerous products they produced. Their initial plan called for an eventual staged incident that would make her powers public, but her conditioning began failing, causing her to vaguely remember names and begin disobeying Dixon's orders. On her way to a remote facility in Brazil, she escaped and returned to Los Angeles where the dormant memories of Starburst led her to the home of Hardcase. ===Meeting Hardcase=== Dodging Interceptors (men in powered armor) sent by the Choice Corporation, she arrived on Hardcase's balcony. They fended off the Interceptors and decide to pay a visit to the Choice corporation. They are ambushed by The Omega Team, whom they defeat. Teaming with The Strangers, Choice and Hardcase attempted to infiltrate the Groom Lake Base of Aladdin (thinking Aladdin was responsible for sending the creature that killed the Squad, NM-E, but were captured. After an escape and battle, Atom Bob threatens to erase Aladdin's data unless they agree to a "non-aggression pact" with Hardcase, Choice and the Strangers. Returning to Los Angeles, Hardcase and Choice visit the Choice Corporation. Due to her conditioning, Choice could not speak publicly against the Choice Corporation, but could speak to Hardcase in private. After a night on the town, Hardcase is nearly killed by Hardwire but he is held off by Choice, who rushes Hardcase to a hospital. amy powell.name: Amy Powell
amy powell.origin: At one point Amy Powell started dating Lance Bannon , and by mutual agreement the two decided to have an open relationship in which they could both hang out with other people. After a couple of years the two began to see other people to provoke one another. At one point Amy thought of making Lance jealous by going out with Peter Parker as his biggest competitor in selling photos to the Daily Bugle, but he ignored her because he was still mourning the apparent death of Black Cat. Amy kept trying to meet Peter, but he could never find him because of his double life. Eventually, Amy managed to invite Peter to have a coffee, and he accepted for sheer education because he had discovered that the Black Cat was alive, and had started a relationship with her. Lance saw everything and decided to intervene. The next day, Lance took Peter to a bar and explained the situation between him and Amy, and irritated the young Parker telephoned the blonde to clarify the situation, but she did not let him talk and made an appointment for eight. Peter decided to go there with Lance so as not to get caught up in a hateful triangle. Amy showed up at Peter's apartment an hour before they were supposed to meet at the restaurant because she wanted to have a picnic indoors. Once she arrived, she started kissing Peter, but was interrupted by the arrival of Peter's ex-girlfriend, Mary Jane Watson, who wanted to give him the keys to the apartment. Soon after, Lance and Amy also arrived if she left angrily; at that point Peter convinced his colleague to run after her. Eventually Lance joined Amy in a bar and the two cleared up deciding to start a serious relationship.

amytis.name: Amytis
amytis.origin: Amytis was Narim-Bey's hot-blooded paramour, whom Conan greeted before leaving the capital for Wan Tengri. When the Cimmerian returned to the city, she offered him the luxury of her palace and, with Narim-Bey gone for a fortnight, engaged him in a romantic affair. After the party held in his honor for rescuing the Princess Yolinda, Amytis visited the haunted Cimmerian and told him that Lilitu, a were-woman, had marked Conan as her own and was behind the supernatural attacks. The only one who could lift the curse was the high priest Gimil-Ishbi, who was dwelling in the Mound of the Moon west of the city. As Conan left for the Mound of the Moon, she revealed to her master that she'd rather see Conan dead, then risk his leaving her one day.

ana cortes.name: Ana Cortés
ana cortes.origin: Ana Cortés was the only child of the founder and CEO of the Cortés Syndicate. At age 18, she inherited the company after her father's death. In the search for true power, she hired Reiko who put Lady Deathstrike's consciousness into Ana's body. Reiko also gave her access to the nanites and provide information about Omega Sentinel. Wanting to get Karima's cybernetic enhancements, Ana organized the attack on the Jean Grey School, but failed due to misinformation about members of the X-Men. She paid Reiko once again to hack the School's systems and provide the proper, current intel about the X-Men and Omega Sentinel, but Reiko found something more interesting - information about Arkea. Ana formed a new Sisterhood of Mutants, recruiting Typhoid Mary, and later Enchantress, and together they helped Arkea to return. Under Arkea's leadership, Enchantress resurrected Selene and planned to resurrect Madelyne Pryor. Afraid of what had become of her life and what Arkea wanted to achieve, Ana contacted the X-Men and told them about the current location of the Sisterhood, and then committed suicide. Arkea extracted Lady Deathstrike's consciousness from Ana's body, and used her powers to reshape it, while Enchantress put Madelyne Pryor's soul into it.

ana shwartz.name: Ana Shwartz
ana shwartz.first_appearance: Venom: Sign of the Boss Vol 1 1
ana shwartz.origin: Born a mutant in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic, as a child Ana Maria Magdalena Shwartz exhibited mutant superpowers and wounds reminiscing of Jesus Christ's crucifixion ones. Taking those as a stigmata and a signal, Ana's grandmother sold the girl to a Catholic orphanage. The Catholic Church understood the girl's powers and their potential, as she could obtain superhuman abilities by invoking out loud the names of different saints, and they recruited her for the Holy Guard, which protected the Vatican and their rich patrons. Shwartz later left the Holy Guard to join a more altruistic Jesuit sect, the Holy Fire, while still being a super-agent of the Catholic church under the alias Stigmata. When Franco Santera, tyrannical dictator and President of small South American country San Gregorio, claimed to have suffered a crisis of faith and had turned to God in repentance, the Vatican Secret Guard assigned Stigmata to determine if the Santera's conversion was genuine, in which case the Vatican would support him. She was to accompany Santera and his family as their bodyguard. Santera had not seen the light, but was faking his religious enlightenment to improve his international image in search of money (In fact, his supposed family were hired actors), and he had planned an elaborate hoax in which terrorists, secretly hired by him, would attack him in public during a visit to the United States, and then Santera would convince the attackers to abandon their methods in a reconciliation. The attackers included the cyborg Teraknid, who was prepared to take on Stigmata's superpowers. Santera decided to visit St. Jude Church, in the Bronx, New York City, without an official invitation from the United States government (which did not want to be closely associated with the dictator). The U.S.'s NSA infiltrated its superhuman agent Venom into the public to protect the foreign dignitary, but he was only supposed to act if he received a signal. Following the plan, when Santera was giving his speech, he was attacked by at least eight terrorists with semi-automatic weapons hidden in the audience. Stigmata, whom they called "mutant garbage", fought them, enraged at the desecration of a sacred place; but, at the urging of Santera, who offered to reason with them, she piously offered to let them go if they forgot her plan. When they didn't, Stigmata defeated several, but Teraknid paralyzed her with his poisonous sting, and then she was bound and gagged, preventing her from using her powers. The terrorists continued with their plan, taking all the attendees hostage, while outside the authorities discussed the jurisdiction to enter the church. The situation escalated when the NSA authorized the brutal Venom to attack, the St. Jude priest was injured and one of the attendees, Daniel Ketch, activated his own powers as Ghost Rider. Venom and the Rider fought each other and at the same time several terrorists were defeated, with Santera losing control of the situation. A nun knocked out Teraknid, and another nun ungagged Stigmata. The Vatican agent invoked the power of the angel Saint Gabriel and, charged with energy, accused Santera of having sinned and deserving a sentence. That gave Ghost Rider the chance to use his Penance Stare on Santera, so that the Santera mind would only remember his immoral acts. The doors of the church opened and, as the terrorists were arrested and the priest receiving medical attention, Stigmata took Santera into her custody, delivering him to a secret Vatican prison in the Italian Alps. Only after the mission was the NSA informed of Stigmata's Vatican affiliation. Stigmata is still active as a Vatican agent today.

fields.personality: A devout Catholic, Stigmata respectfully addresses the saints in prayer when asking for their power, and was particularly incensed when criminals decided to attack in the holy ground of a church, as it was desecration. Being also pious, she offered to stop fighting her enemies if they renounced to their plans and simply left. When using the greatest power of St. Gabriel and adopting her angel-like form, she passed judgement on Santera, condemning her "by the power vested on" Stigmata; it is unclear which power specifically allows her to judge sinners.
abilities: Stigmata is probably fluent in Spanish, as she uttered not only her prayers in Spanish, but also one insult in that language during the St. Jude skirmish (with two exclamation marks).
weaknesses: Stigmata needs to speak out loud, apparently in Spanish, to use her powers.
equipment: She wears both a crucifix and an ankh hanging from her neck.
weapons: Stigmata carries a walking stick she uses as a melee weapon. If she invokes the power of Saint Gabriel, she can charge the stick with energy, to increase the damage.
fields.notes: Name revealed in Official Handbook of the Marvel Universe A to Z #14, Anti-Venom's profile (June 2010). In , Melissa Maro describes Stigmata as "that bald super mutant Spanish Church lady". Stigmata is revealed be not Spanish, nor San Gregorian, but Dominican, in her profile in . She isn't bald either, but she shaves her scalp. It's reasonable for Maro to have been mistaken, as she did not know Stigmata. The injured priest in believed that Stigmata's angelic form was the angel of death, coming to take him. This is proved false, as the priest survived. Stigmata speaks in very mediocre Spanish, making many mistakes while invoking the saints (Like "San José... ayúdame volar!" instead of "¡San José... ayúdame a volar!"), also lacking consistency in diacritics (San José is accented, while Santa Bárbara is not), and sometimes using an exclamation mark at the beginning of a sentence, instead of an inverted exclamation mark. She also uses weird fonts for those moments.

anaconda.origin: ===Early Life=== Originally a steelworker, Blanche Sitznski became a student at Taskmaster's Academy for criminals. She later took on the role as calisthenics instructor, responsible for training female criminals in hand-to-hand combat. Some time later, Blanche was selected by executives in the Roxxon Oil Company to be a special agent in covert operations. At the Mutagenics Laboratory of Roxxon's subsidiary, the Brand Corporation, Sitznski was bioengineered to have various permanent serpentine adaptations. ===Serpent Squad=== left|thumb|"Anaconda" Adopting the codename Anaconda, Sitznski was recruited into Sidewinder's incarnation of the Serpent Squad alongside Black Mamba and Death Adder. They were assigned the task of retrieving the ancient relic known as the Serpent Crown for Roxxon president Hugh Jones. During the mission, the Serpent Squad battled the Thing, Triton, and Stingray. After several battles, Anaconda, Black Mamba, and Death Adder were trapped under the sea while Sidewinder escaped and retrieved the crown for Jones. The trio later escaped and hired out their services as mercenaries. This brought them into conflict with Iron Man, though they were subsequently defeated. ===Serpent Society=== Anaconda and her teammates then sought out Sidewinder, planning revenge on their former leader for abandoning them during their first mission. However, Sidewinder compensated the trio for their roles in the Serpent Crown mission, and invited them to join his next venture: a criminal organization of snake-themed mercenaries known as the Serpent Society. Anaconda and the others agreed to hear Sidewinder's pitch, and traveled across the country to recruit other snake-themed villains. Anaconda returned to her hometown of Pittsburgh to invite Constrictor to the meeting. right|thumb|Anaconda's first battle with Captain America During the initiation test to join the Serpent Society, Anaconda was assigned to steal an apparatus from the Brand Corporation alongside Cobra and Rattler. Constrictor, who had refused to join the Serpent Society, alerted the Avengers to their activities. Captain America ambushed Anaconda and her fellow serpents, though Anaconda ordered Cobra and Rattler to escape with the device while she battled Captain America. After a lengthy battle, Captain America managed to defeat Anaconda and place her in police custody. Later that night, Sidewinder teleported into Anaconda's cell and freed her. Anaconda, knowing Constrictor had tipped off Captain America, beat him to near death as punishment. The Serpent Society's first job was to find and kill M.O.D.O.K. for A.I.M.. Anaconda joined the rest of the Serpent Society as they tracked their target to a nearby shopping mall. After they located M.O.D.O.K., Anaconda was incapacitated by a mind-blast early in the battle. However, despite interference from Captain America, Death Adder and Cottonmouth killed M.O.D.O.K. Anaconda was later sent alongside Cobra, Black Mamba, and Asp to recover M.O.D.O.K.'s body from the morgue and return it to A.I.M. She also offered to kill Princess Python for her cowardice during the M.O.D.O.K. mission, though Sidewinder believed she would be more profitable if they ransomed her to her former team, the Circus of Crime. When Death Adder was murdered by the Scourge of the Underworld, Anaconda vowed to find the murderer and avenge his death. During their early years, the Serpent Society took on the Pride for dominance of the Los Angeles criminal underworld which led to a battle with Iron Man. When the terrorist Viper took over the Serpent Society, Anaconda betrayed Sidewinder and threw her support behind the new leader. At this time, she also became romantically involved with one of the Viper's new members of the group, Puff Adder. When her teammate Diamondback, who had remained loyal to the Society, stormed the Serpent Citadel with Captain America and his allies Nomad, the Falcon, and Demolition Man, Anaconda joined in the fight, battling Diamondback and Demolition Man, though she was knocked unconscious by Diamondback's trick diamonds. The Serpent Society briefly battled the X-Men during a mission where Diamondback had mystically swapped bodies with Dazzler. Anaconda battled Colossus, though as with the rest of her teammates, she was eventually defeated. Anaconda helped Diamondback's date with Captain America (unbeknownst to her at the time) go smoothly. Upon learning that Diamondback knew the true identity of her sworn enemy, Anaconda turned on Diamondback. Anaconda served as bailiff during her trial where she voted guilty. After Sidewinder rescued Diamondback from her death sentence, the Serpent Society were sent to locate her. Alongside Rock Python and Puff Adder, Anaconda waited at Diamondback's apartment in case she returned. There, they encountered Captain America, who they defeated and threw off the roof of the building. Under orders of their new leader, King Cobra, Anaconda and her teammates were not to return to headqu

anakalak.name: Anakalak
anakalak.origin: Anakalak is the guardian of the Nexus of Realities in the alien planet once called Makray by its indigenous race, extinct for almost a million years. Silver Surfer once sought to investigate an anomaly in the interzone between nexuses and wanted to access the interzone though Anakalak's nexus. Anakalak wouldn't let Silver Surfer pass but Silver Surfer was finally able to thwart Anakalak and access the transdimensional realm.

anakin skywalker.name: Anakin Skywalker
anakin skywalker.origin: Anakin Skywalker was a young Jedi in a galaxy far, far away from our galaxy, who turned into the Dark Side of the Force by Darth Sidious to become a Sith Lord known as Darth Vader. Despite being born in a far galaxy, Vader survived into the modern day. He reconciled with his old enemy Yoda, and ended up with the desperate alien species that made-up the world-conquering Conquest. As a member of the Conquest, Vader accompanied them to the planet Earth, until their plans was thwarted by the superhero team the X-Men; however, Vader seemingly take no part of the invasion. At some point later, while visiting Earth, Vader attended the auction of the Venom symbiote held by Eddie Brock at the Ditko Theatre in New York City.

analytical unit for tabulation of origin.origin: A.U.T.O.F.A.C. was a computer a giant computer created to calculate data for S.H.I.E.L.D.. While the A.U.T.O.F.A.C. computer works out the true identity of the Supreme Hydra, Nick Fury plans to have Agent Bronson transport Laura Brown to S.H.I.E.L.D.'s West coast HQ. Just in time as moments later, he's attacked by The Dreadnought, a deadly 8ft tall Hydra killer robot. Laura suspects Bronson may be the Supreme Hydra himself, and her suspicions are confirmed by A.U.T.O.F.A.C., but before she can pass on the info, Bronson overpowers her. Fury just barely manages to beat The Dreadnought, but finds Laura is missing and A.U.T.O.F.A.C. names her as the Supreme Hydra. A.U.T.O.F.A.C. was soon after destroyed by a bomb planted by a HYDRA agent (the same who planted false data to implicate Laura) in a failed attempt to assassinate Fury.

ananastasia rinaldi.name: Ananastasia Rinaldi
ananastasia rinaldi.origin: Ananastasia dropped out of FBI training when she could not complete the psych training, which included handling Bellevue patients. After working as a security specialist in Miami, she was imprisoned for an undisclosed offense under an assumed name. Upon release, Anna was an exotic dancer before discovering a talent for tattoo art. Romanced by several mobsters, including Vincent Calabresse, Anna had a secret affair with an NYPD officer, Fred Pierson. From Calabresse, Anna received full-time bodyguard, Busta Bloodvessel, a former rapper who retired after a heart attack. Anna and Pierson plotted to use Deadpool to free her of her mobster lovers and cash in on a million dollar insurance policy on Pierson's wife. Ananastasia acted as a go-between for Pierson who hired Deadpool to kill Anna’s other lovers under the pretense that the mobsters had threatened his family over Pierson's undercover work. Ananastasia's beauty soon entranced Deadpool, and Anna seemed genuinely attracted to him despite his disfigurements. Following Anna's murder of Pierson's wife, made to look like a mob hit, and Deadpool's botched hit on Calabresse, the sole survivor of Wade's efforts, Deadpool told Ananastasia his suspicions about Bloodvessel being in cahoots with the mobsters. Anna ambushed Deadpool, knocking him unconscious with a shovel, and she and Pierson then buried Deadpool alive. When Pierson told Anna he received much less money than planned, Anna - knowing he was lying - tied up Pierson and returned to save Deadpool. When Pierson told Deadpool the double cross was Anna's idea, she murdered Pierson, as well as Busta's informant, Sandee Savage, with the same gun she used to kill Pierson's wife. Calabresse and Bloodvessel approached as Anna asked Deadpool to run away with her, and a furious Calabresse forced Busta to crash his car in an attempt to kill Anna. The resulting explosion killed Calabresse and left Bloodvessel unconscious. After working as a security specialist in Miami, she was imprisoned for an undisclosed offense under an assumed name. Upon release, Anna was an exotic dancer before discovering a talent for tattoo art. Romanced by several mobsters, including Vincent Calabresse, Anna had a secret affair with an NYPD officer, Fred Pierson. From Calabresse, Anna received full-time bodyguard, Busta Bloodvessel, a former rapper who retired after a heart attack. Anna and Pierson plotted to use Deadpool to free her of her mobster lovers and cash in on a million dollar insurance policy on Pierson's wife. Ananastasia acted as a go-between for Pierson who hired Deadpool to kill Anna’s other lovers under the pretense that the mobsters had threatened his family over Pierson's undercover work. Ananastasia's beauty soon entranced Deadpool, and Anna seemed genuinely attracted to him despite his disfigurements. Following Anna's murder of Pierson's wife, made to look like a mob hit, and Deadpool's botched hit on Calabresse, the sole survivor of Wade's efforts, Deadpool told Ananastasia his suspicions about Bloodvessel being in cahoots with the mobsters. When Pierson told Anna he received much less money than planned, Anna - knowing he was lying - tied up Pierson and returned to save Deadpool. ananym.species: Human with demon ancestry.Category:Human/Demon Hybrids Witchfire is a sorceress, born with her magical powers.
ananym.origin: Ananym is the daughter of Belasco, a sorcerer who formerly ruled the dimension Otherplace (a.k.a Limbo); however she has no memories of her past or her demonic background. When Alpha Flight vanished from Earth, the Canadian government recruited her along with Nemesis, Wild Child, Auric, and Silver to form Gamma Flight as Canada's new national protectors. Upon the return of Alpha Flight, Gamma Flight was ordered to arrest them, but both teams allied against Llan instead. When the government disbanded Gamma Flight, Witchfire chose to remain with Alpha Flight for further training while the rest of her old team departed. Witchfire was assigned to both Alpha Flight's trainee program, Beta Flight, and to their new Gamma Flight support team, specifically for supernatural purposes. Shaman tutored her in other forms of magic; this, combined with the meditative "communing" she regularly engaged in served to help prevent her remembering her unsettling past. After being briefly trapped in the Dreamqueen's realm with fellow Beta Flight members, she returned and was instrumental in Beta Flight's defeating the Master's Omega Flight and in driving the invading Ska'r from the Earth. She naturally assumed leadership of Beta Flight, but when Manikin was injured in battle, her guilt and anger awakened darker feelings and she lashed out, frying the mind of his poisoner, Jackal. The Hardliners invaded the Flight's Department H headquarters and beat Witchfire severely, but despite surgery which required her to shave her head, she soon recovered; however, the darkness in her grew stronger. When her father sought to use her to oppose the Goddess (the universe threatening "good" half of Adam Warlock). She evolved into a powerful demonic form. Under Belasco's control, she began spying on members of Alpha Flight who were under the control of the Goddess (transporting herself across the Solar System to do so) and transformed Department H into an enormous demon-infested obelisk. She more than held her own against Alpha Flight nearly killing them several times, but the recovering Manikin managed to reach her inner humanity and she reverted back into a human with no memory of her true past. When the Canadian government ordered the disbanding of Alpha, Beta, and Gamma Flights, Witchfire left to find her own place in the world. She ended up using her father's Bloodstones to form a portal to let the Elder Gods into Limbo, extracting the fifth and final stone needed from Pixie's soul. Witchfire has also been recruited into Hydra's Department of Occult Affairs.

anastasia contrares.name: Anastasia Contrares
anastasia contrares.origin: Anastasia Contrares was born in 1940 and grew up to be something of a street racing legend around the town of Revelation, Arizona by the 1950s. She was involved in a fatal car accident in the year 1961. Since then her ghost continued to drive the highways around the town in her trademark Eldorado. In the Modern Age, the Fantastic Four's Human Torch was rescued from the side of a highway while the team was investigating some strange activity in the town of Revelation. Having just been attacked by a local monster known as the Howler, Johnny narrowly avoided getting run over by Contrares. She offered him a ride back into town. When they arrived they learned that Johnny's teammates had uncovered that the last surviving members of the Z'lyztayan race was hiding in the town in order to escape the threat of the Obliterator and that Mister Fantastic's recent space probes led the Obliterator to Earth. Anastasia helped the Fantastic Four stop the Obliterator from completing its mission. By this time, Johnny had developed a crush on the hot-rodding woman. However, he was soon informed that Anastasia was actually a ghost and learned how she died when one of the Z'lyztayans showed Johnny her grave. Presumably, Contrares' spirit continues to drive the highways around Revelation. However, her subsequent activities are unknown.

anastasia inyushin.name: Anastasia Inyushin
anastasia inyushin.origin: thumb|left|200px Anastasia 'Stasi' Inyushin was a Russian girl with the paranormal ability to make plants grow. She was being tested by the KGB at the facility known as the Siberian Project when the so-called White Event boosted her powers to an incredible degree, giving her the power to heal seemingly any illness or injury in any living thing. Rescued and brought to America by Emmett Proudhawk, Stasi became a member of Psi-Force, the quintet of youths with paranormal powers that Proudhawk had gathered together out of a desire to protect them. The gentle, duty and loyalty driven Stasi remained with the group, her surrogate family, following Proudhawk's death. Due to a misunderstanding, she was later shot dead by the US Army.

anastasia nikolaevna.name: Anastasia Nikolaevna
anastasia nikolaevna.origin: Grand Duchess Anastasia Nikolaevna of Russia was the youngest daughter of Tsar Nicholas II, the last sovereign of Imperial Russia, and his wife, Tsarina Alexandra Feodorovna. ===Russian Revolution=== Her father abdicated and they were exiled to the Siberian city of Yekaterinburg. On July 17, 1918, with the anti-communist White Army closing in on the city, the former Tsar, his wife Tsarina Alexandra, and their five children were all executed by Bolshevik soldiers. Anastasia however was able to escape and went into hiding before passing away in a Berlin hospital.

anath na mut.name: Anath-Na Mut
anath na mut.species: Mutant genetically engineered and trained by the Caretakers of Arcturus; Using the Ka Stone; mutate
anath na mut.origin: The man who would become the Sphinx was the chief wizard in the court of the ancient Egyptian Pharaoh Ramses II, and in fact a mutant. When the wizard's apparent magical abilities proved to be inferior to the powers demonstrated by Moses, the leader of the captive Israelites, Ramses banished the wizard. After years of wandering, the wizard happened upon a temple of unknown origin, inside which was the mystical Ka Stone. The mystical stone seemed to bid him to touch it to his forehead. The moment he did so, the stone affixed itself to him and imbued him with vast superhuman powers and immortality. The wizard assumed the name of the Sphinx and spent the next 5,000 years traveling the Earth without purpose, involving himself in whichever endeavors of mankind struck his fancy. Eventually the Sphinx became profoundly bored with his immortal life and began to search for a means to free himself from the Ka stone and its unwanted powers. Hearing of a being whose powers rivaled his own, he traveled to the Himalayan mountains where he encountered the enigmatic mystical entity he called Sayge. Sayge refused to help him and tormented him for unknown reasons with his predictions of the Sphinx's supposedly unalterable destiny of eternal life. Sayge, also known as Veritas, the embodiment of truth, frequently accompanied the Sphinx, again for reasons that remain unknown. By the mid-twentieth century the Sphinx had probed thousands of minds in search of knowledge towards a means of ending his life, but to no avail. He then tapped the mind of Richard Rider, a youth who at that time possessed the powers of a Nova Centurion, a superhumanoid champion from the planet Xandar. Rider's subconscious mind had been imprinted with the knowledge possessed by his alien predecessor, including knowledge of Xandar's planet-size computer. The Sphinx, unaware of the precise nature of Rider's knowledge, nevertheless believed the youth to possess the secret of thwarting the Ka stone. Because this knowledge was in his subconscious, however, Rider managed to resist the Sphinx's efforts to wrest it from him. Eventually, the Sphinx learned of Xandar from the "living computer" Quasimodo. The Sphinx pressed Rider and a number of the latter's allies and opponents into accompanying him to Xandar in the starship that Rider had inherited from his Nova Centurion predecessor. Reaching Xandar, the Sphinx absorbed the sum total of that world's accumulated knowledge by absorbing it from Xandar's central computer. The Sphinx also absorbed tremendous amounts of energy from the planet-sized computer. Now, at last, the Sphinx had sufficient knowledge and power to end his life. However, he abandoned his goal of suicide, and instead decided to return to Earth to destroy it. Learning of his intent, the superhuman champions known as the Fantastic Four contacted the world eater Galactus and bargained with him to battle the Sphinx. The Fantastic Four believed that only a being as mighty as Galactus could defeat the Sphinx, who was now vastly more powerful than ever before. Galactus did indeed defeat the Sphinx in battle, deprived him of his added power from the computer system of Xandar, plucked the Ka stone from his forehead, crushed it, and used his immense powers to dispatch the Sphinx back in time to relive his life over and over eternally in a "time loop." However, Galactus, whose knowledge of time travel was rudimentary, failed to take into account the fact that the Sphinx already existed at the time period to which he had sent him. Therefore, there were now two Sphinxes at that time period, who met at the point in time when the Sphinx first discovered the Ka stone. Sayge refused to help him and tormented him for unknown reasons with his predictions of the Sphinx's supposedly unalterable destiny of eternal life. He then tapped the mind of Richard Rider, a youth who at that time possessed the powers of a Nova Centurion, a superhumanoid champion from the planet Xandar. Rider's subconscious mind had been imprinted with the knowledge possessed by his alien predecessor, including knowledge of Xandar's planet-size computer. fields.trivia: According to , the Sphinx was a mutant who was genetically engineered and trained by the Caretakers of Arcturus. This information seems to be at odds with the rest of his appearances. The Sphinx's Ka Stone is a fragment of the Lifestone Tree. Other beings empowered by fragments of the Lifestone Tree include Ulysses Bloodstone, Moonstone, Basilisk, Blue Diamond, Dr. Spectrum, and Man-Wolf. The story of Anath-Na Mut confronting Moses as the chief magician of Pharaoh Ramses comes from the Bible. Interestingly, the same Bible story was adopted into DC Comics continuity. There, the pharaoh's magician who opposed Moses was , Lord of Order and future patron of .

anathi.first_appearance: Marvel Realm of Champions: Realm on the March Season 1 1
anathi.origin: Anathi was a reporter from the Kingdom of Wakanda with a show that discussed Battleworld's current events. Anathi analyzed the mystery surrounding the Maestro's assassination in a segment of her show called The Maestro Files. thumb|left|200px|Anathi's arm fused to the Infinity Gauntlet|Infinity Claw. After a year of investigating the Maestro's death, Anathi returned to the Maestro's throne room at the whim of an anonymous tip. The eight Battleworld Barons who she encountered there confirmed her suspicions that they had all been involved in the Maestro's demise. The Ancient One elaborated by using his Time Stone to transport Anathi and himself to the Maestro's death, showing her that their multiversal counterparts aided them. The two were spotted by Glykhan, who abducted Anathi to the Chronoserpent's asteroid for questioning. Fortunately, Anathi recieved the Infinity Claw from an alternate T'Challa and exhausted its power to free herself from the Chronoserpent, causing her arm to fuse with the gauntlet's remnants. As a battle waged between the Chronoserpent and Galactus, Anathi was among those who evacuated from Battleworld to the Battlerealm.
